jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Wil jij je technische talent inzetten om een maatschappelijke bijdrage te leveren aan de zorg? Word jij enthousiast van het bouwen aan de infrastructuur, koppelingen en cloud-omgevingen die de zorg écht slimmer maken? Lees dan verder, want bij Bince doe je dit elke dag.

Functieomschrijving

Wat ga je doen?

Als System Engineer zorg jij ervoor dat onze technische infrastructuur en koppelingen stabiel, veilig en schaalbaar blijven draaien. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe koppelingen en ontsluit systemen voor klanten, en je bouwt en beheert onze Infrastructure as Code. Wanneer er problemen ontstaan, zoals koppelingen die niet werken, toegangsproblemen of ontbrekende functionaliteiten, pak jij deze ad hoc op en voer je het incident- en changemanagement uit.

Jij zet de ruwe data in de database klaar zodat de Data Engineer hiermee verder kan werken, en je stemt dit af met de Data Engineers en de BI-consultants. Je zorgt dat de VM's elke nacht blijven draaien en werkt dagelijks in Azure, waar je resources aanmaakt die vervolgens door het team worden gebruikt. Je kent de BinceBase codebase, gebruikt deze en ontwikkelt deze verder door: je breidt het platform uit met nieuwe functionaliteiten en koppelingen, optimaliseert bestaande omgevingen en tools, en ontdekt en implementeert nieuwe systemen.

Je bent alert op mogelijkheden om efficiënter te werken: je automatiseert repeterende taken van collega's, houdt de kostenefficiëntie in Azure scherp in de gaten en verbetert de stabiliteit van onze omgevingen. Je kent de beschikbare technische toolbox en het informatiemodel (de architectuur) en past dit toe. Daarnaast consulteer en voed je de CTO, en ben je het aanspreekpunt voor collega's en externe partijen (zoals klanten en leveranciers) op jouw vakgebied. Je bent ondersteunend bij tweedelijnsincidenten, lost problemen op waar collega's of klanten mee komen en zorgt dat de systemen stabiel blijven. Bij afwezigheid van de System Administrator pak jij de taken van deze functie op indien nodig.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent in de eerste plaats een technische probleemoplosser met hart voor stabiele, veilige systemen. Je krijgt energie van het bouwen, optimaliseren en bewaken van infrastructuur en koppelingen. Je werkt gestructureerd en zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op met je team en de CTO als dat nodig is.

Harde eisen voor deze functie zijn:

Aantoonbare ervaring met cloudplatformen zoals Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud of AWS
Ervaring met versiebeheer (GIT)
Ervaring met het ontsluiten van bronnen, onder andere via API's
Ervaring met PowerShell of Bash
Ervaring met Python

Het is een pré als je ervaring hebt met:

SQL
Bicep (Infrastructure as Code)

Bij Bince staan de volgende competenties centraal:

Betrouwbaarheid
Je bent iemand op wie we kunnen bouwen. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van je werk, documenteert je werkzaamheden op goede wijze en zorgt dat systemen blijven doen wat ze moeten doen.

Nieuwsgierigheid
Je signaleert kansen voor doorontwikkeling en innovatie van BinceBase en onze techniek, en bent gedreven om jezelf en je kennis up-to-date te houden.

Zelfstandigheid en samenwerking
Je kunt goed schakelen tussen meerdere taken en stelt de juiste prioriteiten, die je periodiek afstemt met de CTO en de Manager Operations. Je bent een teamplayer die goed samenwerkt met je team en de klant, maar ook prima zelfstandig je werkzaamheden verricht.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

Dat de data elke nacht binnenkomt, zodat data van de gemaakte koppelingen elke nacht actueel is
Het optimaliseren van de snelheid en stabiliteit van de nachtelijke verversingen
Het bouwen en beheren van technische oplossingen volgens de beschikbare richtlijnen en documentatie, en het signaleren van verbeteringen bij de CTO
Het volgen van kansen voor innovatie en doorontwikkeling van bestaande oplossingen, en het doorvoeren hiervan met de juiste documentatie en communicatie
Het beheren en uitvoeren van je eigen taken in DevOps
De beveiliging van bestaande en toekomstige oplossingen

Waar kom je te werken?

Bince is een vooruitstrevend bedrijf dat zich inzet om de zorg slimmer te maken met behulp van data. We zien dat de zorgsector onder druk staat: de vraag stijgt, terwijl het aantal zorgverleners daalt. Wij geloven dat goede data toepassingen helpen om die kloof te overbruggen en daar werken we elke dag aan.

Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team van 23 collega's: van BI-specialisten tot engineers, van sales tot management. Wat ons verbindt is de overtuiging dat data het verschil kan maken. We werken hybride, met veel onderlinge samenwerking én ruimte voor jouw inbreng.

We leren continu, blijven onszelf ontwikkelen en helpen elkaar vooruit; net zoals we dat voor onze klanten doen.

Primaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

Salarisrange: €4.000 – €5.500 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring)
Fulltime dienstverband (32 tot 40 uur bespreekbaar)
8% vakantiegeld
Hybride werken: gedeeltelijk thuis en op ons mooie kantoor in Assen
Een fijne balans tussen vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid

Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

13e maand in december (naar rato dienstverband)
Pensioenregeling bij Allianz
Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of mogelijkheid tot leaseauto
MacBook & iPhone voor zakelijk gebruik
26 vakantiedagen o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband
Jaarlijks opleidingsbudget van €1.000 voor hard- en soft-skills
Regelmatig teamactiviteiten zoals sportieve activiteiten, vrijmibo's en weekendjes weg

Wat nu?

Wanneer jij jezelf herkent in de kennis en ervaring die wij zoeken om ons team te versterken, dan komen wij graag met je in contact!

Zo ziet het proces eruit:

Kennismaking : Onze recruiter Daniel neemt contact met je op voor een (online) gesprek waarin we elkaar leren kennen.
Vervolggesprek : Bij wederzijds enthousiasme volgt een gesprek met Jelle (Manager Operations) en Eddy (CTO).
Inhoudelijk gesprek : Samen met Gjalt (System Engineer) en Dirk Jelle (System Engineer) duiken we de diepte in.
Aanbieding: Als de klik er is, volgt snel een aanbod en bespreken we de arbeidsvoorwaarden persoonlijk.

We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem dan contact op met Daniel op 06-23509116 of danielgerzee@bince.nl.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Stellenbeschreibung:

Als Familienunternehmen steht Brasseler seit über 100 Jahren dafür, mit seinen Produkten für die Zahnmedizin und Chirurgie die Lebensqualität von Menschen weltweit zu verbessern. Was 1923 mit einer visionären Idee begann, hat international Erfolgsgeschichte geschrieben: Mit der Entwicklung zum global tätigen MedTech-Unternehmen aus Ostwestfalen-Lippe ist Brasseler heute einer der bedeutendsten Arbeitgeber in der Region. Brasseler ist seit Gründung in Familienbesitz, die gemeinsame Wertebasis des Familienunternehmens ist geprägt von langfristigem Denken und dem Blick für den Menschen. Weltweit beschäftigt das Unternehmen rund 1.500 Mitarbeiter, darunter 1.300 am Firmensitz in Lemgo.

Wir suchen für den Bereich IT einen

IT Integration Engineer (m/w/d) für Schnittstellen und Datenintegration

Unsere Enterprise Applications bilden zentrale Geschäftsprozesse ab. Damit sie stabil zusammenarbeiten, brauchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Integrationen nicht als unsichtbare Technik versteht, sondern als produktive Unternehmensassets: mit klarer Verantwortung, sauberer Dokumentation und einem belastbaren Betrieb.

Als IT Integration Engineer (m/w/d) konzipieren, entwickeln, betreiben und verbessern Sie Datenflüsse im Microsoft-Umfeld – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Application-Ownern, dem Stammdatenmanagement, der IT-Entwicklung, dem IT-Betrieb, der Informationssicherheit und externen Partnern.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Sie dokumentieren unsere Schnittstellenlandschaft: Quelle, Ziel, Datenobjekt, Prozessbezug, Kritikalität, Verantwortlichkeiten und Betriebsmodell sind für relevante Datenflüsse transparent und aktuell
Sie entwerfen, entwickeln, konfigurieren, testen und betreiben Integrationen auf Basis etablierter Microsoft-Technologien – beispielsweise APIs, Events, Dateiübertragungen und ETL-Strecken
Sie stellen mit Monitoring, Alerting, Fehleranalyse, Wiederanlauf und Betriebsdokumentation sicher, dass produktive Datenflüsse zuverlässig laufen und Störungen strukturiert behandelt werden
Sie begleiten Changes, Releases, Tests, Go-lives und Migrationen mit Integrationswirkung und sichern technische Nachweise sowie die Rückverfolgbarkeit in Azure DevOps
Sie bewerten Anforderungen hinsichtlich ihrer Integrationsauswirkungen und erarbeiten tragfähige technische Lösungen – von Standardintegration und Konfiguration bis zur technischen Weiterentwicklung
Sie arbeiten an produktiven Datenflüssen zwischen Enterprise Applications, Plattformen, Partnern und Datenkonsumenten – damit Informationen systemübergreifend zuverlässig verarbeitet, überwacht und bei Fehlern wiederhergestellt werden können
Sie analysieren wiederkehrende Störungen im Second-Level-Support, stimmen sich mit Fachbereichen ab und überführen Verbesserungen in ein nachvollziehbares Backlog
Sie koordinieren externe Implementierungspartner bei Schnittstellenthemen und sichern Test-, Abnahme- und Betriebsnachweise

Ihr Profil:

Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, eine IT-Ausbildung mit passender Berufserfahrung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Erste bis mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Systemintegrationen, Schnittstellenbetrieb oder Datenflüssen – idealerweise in einer Unternehmens- oder ERP-nahen IT-Landschaft
Gute Kenntnisse über REST- / SOAP-APIs, Datenformate wie auch synchrone und asynchrone Integrationsmuster sowie in der Authentifizierung und im Mapping; Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure Integration Services, z. B. API Management, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid oder Azure Data Factory, sowie mit SQL Server und SSIS; Kenntnisse in Dataverse, Power Platform und Microsoft Fabric von Vorteil
Programmierkenntnisse in C#, .NET, PowerShell oder Python wünschenswert; Fähigkeit, strukturiert zu arbeiten, nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren und auch im Fehlerfall die Auswirkungen auf Geschäftsprozesse, die technischen Ursachen und einen sicheren Wiederanlauf im Blick zu behalten
Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder anderen ERP-Systemen
Kompetenz, technische Sachverhalte verständlich mit Fachbereichen, IT-Teams und externen Partnern zu klären
Gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau nach GER

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

jobs.title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.  
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement:
fluency in German or Spanish
Location:
Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA
Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
 Key Responsibilities:New Business and Client Engagement Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

 About You:Essential 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

 What Success Looks Like: Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

 to push the boundaries of what’s possible

 to do groundbreaking work

to exceed expectations

jobs.description:
Job Description

Wir bei DXC Technology suchen eine:n Java Software Engineer
mit architektonischem Verständnis.

In dieser Rolle entwickeln Sie gemeinsam mit unseren Teams individuelle Softwarelösungen für Kundenprojekte – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Entwicklern sowie den Architekten unserer Kunden zusammen, um nachhaltige Software-Architekturen zu gestalten. Die Position kann hybrid ausgeübt werden. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich
, da die Projekte national und international stattfinden.

Standort: Erfurt

Ihre Aufgaben

Als Software-Entwickler und -Architekt ergeben sich für Sie folgende Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte:

Sie setzen Anforderungen in Programmcode um und verwenden dabei bestehende sowie neue Frameworks.
Aus Ihrem Verständnis für individuelle Software-Architekturen unserer Kunden leiten Sie technische Umsetzungsvorschläge ab.
Sie strukturieren Umsetzungsprojekte in Arbeitspakete für unsere Entwickler-Teams.
Sie stimmen Umsetzungen mit Architekten unserer Kunden ab.
Sie dokumentieren Umsetzungen in Code-Kommentaren, Umsetzungsvorschlägen und Spezifikationen in deutscher und englischer Sprache, abhängig vom Projektumfeld.

Folgende Fähigkeiten Und Erfahrungen Sollten Sie Mitbringen

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Java-Entwickler, auch in agilen Projektumfeldern
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, JUnit, Git, relationalen Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL, MariaDB oder Oracle DB, Web-Technologien
Umsetzungserfahrungen in Architekturen und Frameworks wie JEE, Hibernate, JSF, Primefaces, React, Angular, JavaFX
Erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Software-Architektur
Hohes Maß an Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil, Aber Nicht Zwingend Erforderlich

Kenntnisse in kryptografischen Verfahren sowie Implementierungen von Benutzer-Authentifizierung und -Autorisierung, MFA, eID (z. B. Keycloak, EIDAS, LDAP)
Erfahrung mit DevOps-Ansätzen inkl. Tools wie Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, SonarQube
Kenntnisse zu APIs inkl. automatisierter Tests ggf. unter Verwendung selbst erstellter Mockups/Simulatoren
Erfahrungen in Datenmigrationsprojekten
Kenntnisse weiterer Programmiersprachen
Erstellung automatisierter Testfälle mit Tools wie Selenium, Jira XRay
Erfahrungen mit Infrastructure as Code und Cloudplattformen von Hyperscalern wie AWS, Azure oder Google
Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden im öffentlichen Sektor
Relevante Zertifizierungen im Java-Umfeld (OCPJ), ISAQB, TOGAF, V-Modell XT, Scrum Master oder Zertifizierungen der Hyperscaler Cloud-Anbieter.

Darüber Hinaus Sollten Sie Mitbringen

Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, mehrjährige Berufserfahrung nach abgeschlossener IHK-Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Bereitschaft zu internen und externen Weiterbildungen
Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisetätigkeiten im In- und Ausland

Was Wir Ihnen Bieten

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
Attraktives Vergütungspaket
Trainings- und Mentoring-Programme zur Unterstützung Ihrer Karriere
Möglichkeit, mit modernsten Technologien in hochentwickelten Enterprise-Umgebungen zu arbeiten und Services für internationale Kunden bereitzustellen
Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte bei einem der weltweit größten IT-Dienstleister – kombiniert mit schnellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und spannenden Aufgaben bei hohem Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

Bei DXC sind es die einzigartigen Beiträge unserer Mitarbeitenden, die uns erfolgreich machen. Jede Idee und jede Person zählt. Unsere inklusive Unternehmenskultur stärkt unsere Leistung – und unser Unternehmen wächst nur, wenn unsere Mitarbeitenden wachsen.

RISE with SAP and SCM module exposure (SD/MM/EWM) a plus

jobs.description:
Over the past 30 years, we’ve grown from humble beginnings with a single computer into a diversified, global, technology-enabled lottery and prize draw company (ASX: JIN). Today, Jumbo operates across Australia, the UK, Canada and the US, bringing together technology, creativity and purpose to create premium digital experiences people love.

Based in Galgate, StarVale is dedicated to strengthening the fundraising power of charities, not‑for‑profits, and hospices across the UK. We combine specialist lottery management with a genuine commitment to helping organisations maximise their impact, so more communities receive the support they deserve.

What will you be doing?

We’re looking for a .NET Web Developer to join us in this hands‑on build‑and‑migrate role. You will be rewriting existing PHP websites in .NET, integrating them with our business systems, and helping shape how we structure our shared architecture going forward. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you will support day‑to‑day business needs, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to high‑quality engineering practices through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solution design.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Your daily work will centre on maintaining, modernising, and progressively transforming our legacy .NET systems while supporting the smooth running of core business operations across StarVale. You can expect to:

Design and build ASP.NET Core websites targeting modern .NET versions (including .NET 10)
Migrate Laravel and CodeIgniter sites to the .NET platform while preserving functionality, SEO, and data integrity
Work with Umbraco CMS — extending existing implementations or building new sites where appropriate
Integrate websites with core .NET business systems and SQL Server databases
Write and maintain EF Core data access code, including migrating data from MySQL to SQL Server
Document business logic and edge cases from existing PHP sites before decommissioning
Contribute to shared architecture decisions, internal libraries, and coding standards
Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

What You’ll Be Able to Bring to the Role

Essential

Solid commercial experience with C# and ASP.NET Core (or strong ASP.NET MVC experience with a clear path to Core)
Experience with Entity Framework Core (or EF) and relational databases (SQL Server)
Comfortable working with front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside server-rendered .NET views or Razor Pages
Experience migrating or integrating systems between different platforms or frameworks
Ability to read and understand PHP (Laravel and/or CodeIgniter) well enough to translate existing functionality into .NET — you won't be writing new PHP, but you'll need to understand what's there
Good understanding of web fundamentals: routing, authentication, forms, SEO basics (URL structure, redirects)

Mindset & Soft Skills

Migration Mindset: Confidence to evaluate legacy code, challenge outdated practices, and guide non-technical stakeholders through modernized technical solutions.
Problem Solver: Highly resourceful with strong initiative, able to own projects independently from requirements-gathering to deployment.
Communication: Excellent people skills to liaise effectively between technical teams, external auditors, and cross-departmental stakeholders.

Preferred:

Experience with Umbraco CMS
Experience with Blazor
Familiarity with Azure or other cloud hosting for .NET applications
Experience leading or contributing to a platform migration or legacy system modernization
Understanding of REST API design, for connecting websites to internal business systems
Ability to work within agile environments, including Kanban and Sprints.

Salary Banding: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience.

Our Ways of Working

At StarVale, we value balance and flexibility. You will be based in our office in Galgate, Lancaster. This role is a flexible hybrid, typically averaging 50% in the office (2-3 days per week). We prioritise results and collaborate to make sure everyone can contribute effectively, while enjoying flexibility and balance in how they work.

Why Join StarVale?

Find Your Freedom - https://bit.ly/Jumbointeractive

An annual regional bonus scheme that rewards your contributions, dependent on company performance.
25 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off.
Access to our Employee Assistance Program, providing counselling and coaching.
Reward & Recognition programme and length of service benefits.
The freedom to work from almost* anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks a year.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Architecture & Algorithms
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA Instruments™ is our instrumentation division, which designs advanced metrology and inspection instruments used in both R&D and production across industries and academia. Our tools—ranging from optical profilers and nano-indenters to thin film and defect inspection systems—enable precise surface and material analysis. We partner closely with customers to enable R&D, improve yield, optimize processes, and reduce production costs through innovative hardware, software and application expertise.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on architecture and algorithms, you will define the software architecture and design the core measurement, data-analysis, and signal/image-processing algorithms that power our families of surface profiler, thin film, sheet resistance and nanoindentation measurement instruments, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and the latest advancements in software engineering and AI/ML/DL.

Responsibilities:

Deliver well-defined features/components with high-level guidance: estimate work, communicate risks/tradeoffs, and deliver on schedule
Own and evolve the software architecture across the development lifecycle—defining system- and subsystem-level requirements, interfaces, and specifications, and guiding key design decisions
Design, implement, and optimize core algorithms for measurement, data analysis, and signal/image processing, including numerical methods and high-performance multithreaded code
Develop C#/.NET and C++ software for data analysis and algorithm implementation; write maintainable, well-structured code and use AI-assisted tools responsibly under company security policies
Evaluate and compare algorithmic approaches through prototyping, benchmarking, and analysis of accuracy, precision, and computational complexity
Build robust unit/integration tests and use profiling to improve algorithm performance, accuracy, memory usage, reliability, and security
Participate in design reviews and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and subject matter experts
Troubleshoot system/subsystem issues using logs and experiments; contribute to root-cause analysis, implement fixes with guidance, and help prevent recurrence
Demonstrate motivation to independently learn and apply new software technologies

Travel - Occasional travel may be required to KLA headquarters, customer sites, or other business locations. Travel is expected to be less than 10% of working time.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree (required) + Significant relevant experience; Master’s or advanced degree (desired) + relevant experience in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, Physics, or Mathematics.
A solid understanding and demonstrated track record in the practice of software engineering fundamentals, including software architecture, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, event-driven design, multithreaded design, testing, and debugging.
Strong foundation in algorithms and numerical methods, with the ability to design, analyze, and optimize algorithms for accuracy and performance
Experience with:
Microsoft .NET languages including VB.NET and C#
C++ programming
Microsoft Visual Studio development environment
Source code control systems such as Git
Adherence to software design and coding standards

Ability to communicate effectively with peers, interdisciplinary engineering groups, customers, and suppliers, including delivering clear technical presentations
Adept at collaborating with teams across the US, Europe, and Asia
Self-driven individual with strong technical ability, a systematic approach, and excellent problem-solving skills

Preferred:

Experience contributing to architecture and design for complex subsystems and influencing technical decisions through strong design and code reviews
Experience developing scientific, measurement, or signal/image-processing algorithms
Background in applied mathematics, numerical methods, statistics, or scientific computing
Experience improving performance and diagnostics/observability for system-level software
Experience collaborating across teams on system integration and software releases for complex systems
Experience delivering AI/ML capabilities in products
UX skills including wireframing, prototyping, and user flow design

Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role

What we will offer you?

KLA’s benefits package includes:

Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, share scheme, rewards scheme and life assurance

Minimum Qualifications

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

CI/CD and build automation - approximately 30%: Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows

You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.

🚀 Founded in 2016, Ekco has quickly become one of Europe’s fastest-growing cloud solution providers and your trusted security-first Managed Service Provider.

IT leaders choose Ekco to drive operational efficiency, scale smarter and stay ahead of risk – powered by local expertise, delivered at European scale.

At Ekco, How We Work Matters As Much As What We Deliver. Our People Live By Four Core Values That Shape Everything We Do

On It: We take ownership, follow through, and get things done.
All In : We collaborate, support each other, and commit fully to shared goals.
Connected: We build trusted relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners.
Hungry to Grow: We stay curious, keep learning, and push ourselves to the next level.

🏠If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role

Day-to-day At Ekco

Operations and support

Provide 2nd/3rd line support for customer cloud platforms, resolving incidents, service requests and problems within agreed SLAs
Monitor platform health, performance and availability, and respond proactively to alerts
Carry out change management in line with ITIL processes, including planning, peer review and implementation of changes
Participate in an on-call rota (with additional allowance)

Build and delivery

Design and deploy cloud infrastructure, including landing zones, networking, identity, compute, storage and PaaS services
Deliver migrations from on-premises and other clouds into Azure/AWS
Produce clear technical documentation, runbooks and handover materials

DevOps and platform engineering

Design, build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state management and workspace/environment strategies across multiple customers
Deploy, operate and upgrade Kubernetes clusters (AKS, EKS), including node pool management, networking (CNI, ingress controllers), RBAC and cluster security
Build and manage container images and registries (ACR, ECR), including image scanning and lifecycle policies
Implement observability across platforms and clusters using Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog, with meaningful alerting rather than noise
Support customers' development teams with platform guidance, pipeline design and deployment best practice

Automation and continuous improvement

Identify repetitive operational tasks and automate them using PowerShell, Python, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Lambda or similar
Contribute to our internal automation and tooling, helping standardise how we build and run customer environments
Recommend and implement improvements to security posture, resilience and cost efficiency

Customer engagement

Work directly with customers and internal Technical Account Managers to understand requirements and deliver outcomes
Contribute to service reviews and technical roadmap discussions
Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across the team

Essential

About you:

Solid hands-on experience with Azure production environments
Strong Terraform experience
Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, ideally AKS or EKS
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Scripting ability in PowerShell, Python and/or Bash
Strong understanding of cloud networking and identity (VNets/VPCs, DNS, private endpoints, VPN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, Entra ID, IAM)
Experience with Docker and container-based application delivery
Comfortable supporting live services within ITIL-based processes and SLAs, using tools such as ServiceNow, ConnectWise or Halo
Clear communicator, able to work directly with customers and their development teams

Desirable

Previous MSP or multi-tenant experience
Terraform Cloud/Enterprise
Serverless (Azure Functions, Lambda) and event-driven architectures
Knowledge of backup and DR tooling (Azure Backup, Veeam, AWS Backup)

Certifications (desirable, or willingness to achieve)

Microsoft: AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305
HashiCorp Terraform Associate
CNCF: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or CKAD

Benefits / Perks

☀️ Time Off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays
🎂 Birthday Leave: One extra day off to celebrate
💰 Company Pension Scheme
📞 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for wellbeing support
🏃‍♀️ EkcOlympics: Global team activity challenges
📚 Unlimited access to Pluralsight for continuous development
🌱 Real opportunities to grow, including international progression

Why Ekco

🏅 Company of the year 2026 Tech Excellence Awards
⭐️ Microsoft’s 2023 Rising Star Security Partner of the Year
🚀 First Irish Microsoft MSP to achieve all four Microsoft Security Specializations
🌈 A culture rooted in diversity, equality, inclusion & belonging
🎉 A commitment to internal mobility and career progression
✨ Flexible, family-friendly working at the heart of our culture

jobs.description:
Use your back-end skills to build the systems behind Ignite Hubs’ website and digital products, enabling more children and young people to access impactful learning opportunities.

What difference will you make?

Play a vital role in helping Ignite Hubs deliver high-quality, inclusive education to children and young people who need it most. We work particularly with girls, those from disadvantaged backgrounds, and those from underrepresented backgrounds in STEM. Your contribution directly supports educational equity and helps young people develop skills critical to future learning and opportunities.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with at least three years’ professional back-end development experience.

You should have experience designing and building APIs, databases and integrations for web applications. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Salesforce and relational databases is particularly relevant to this role.

Ignite Hubs currently uses Salesforce as a core system and is planning a future transition to Supabase. Experience working with Salesforce data, APIs or integrations, and supporting data migration from legacy systems to PostgreSQL or Supabase, would therefore be valuable.

You should understand user authentication, access permissions, secure handling of personal data and payment integrations. Experience with Stripe or similar payment providers would be helpful.

We would particularly welcome experience of Azure hosting, deployment pipelines, cloud databases and integrating multiple digital systems.

Remote

What will you be doing?

We are looking for a Senior Back-end Developer to help build and improve the systems behind Ignite Hubs’ digital products.

Your initial focus will be our new website, including the systems that support registration, booking, user accounts and payments. You may also support technical work across the Ignite Learning & Careers Hub and Ignite Portal, which are being developed by volunteers and external partners.

Working with Product Owners, front-end developers and other technical volunteers, you will

Design and build secure, maintainable back-end services and APIs.
Support the development of registration, booking, account and payment functionality.
Help design and manage databases, data relationships and user permissions.
Connect the website with relevant external systems and services.
Review back-end code and provide constructive feedback to junior developers.
Help investigate and resolve technical issues, bugs and integration problems.
Help ensure that systems can be maintained and developed as Ignite Hubs grows.

jobs.description:
QA Test Engineer – Full-time, Permanent

Location:
Poole, Dorset (4 days per week onsite)
Salary:
£35-40,000 per annum, negotiable depending on experience, plus benefits

The Opportunity:

If you work in QA, you may know how frustrating it is to be brought in at the end of a project, handed a release, and expected to find everything that could go wrong without having had the opportunity to influence it earlier.

This role offers something more involving.

You’ll join an established software company that is investing in modern development tools and testing approaches. Working closely with developers, product specialists and DevOps throughout the Agile delivery cycle, you’ll help shape test coverage, identify risks, and improve how quality is built into complex software. Not simply check it at the end.

The work spans web, mobile and API-based applications, combining thoughtful manual and exploratory testing with automation. With varied projects, technically interesting problems, and software used at scale, this is an opportunity to keep learning while making a visible contribution to the reliability, security and performance of the product.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Salary is competitive and negotiable, up to around £40,000 per annum depending on experience
Annual salary reviews with regular market benchmarking
Hybrid working – 1 day per week remote from home
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Pension scheme with employer contribution and matched enhancements
Health Cash Plan including 24/7 GP access, dental and optical cover
Death in Service cover (4x salary)
Employee Assistance Programme
Paid volunteering days
Discretionary bonus
Comfortable, modern open-plan office
Team and company social events
Autonomy, trust and long-term career progression
Structured training and development opportunities to help you grow
Supportive, team-focused culture that values your ideas and achievements

Why This QA Test Engineer Role May Appeal

Quality is treated as a shared responsibility, with close collaboration across QA, development, product and DevOps.
You’ll work across manual, exploratory and automated testing rather than being confined to repetitive regression testing.
The company has ambitious plans to modernise its development tools and testing approaches, giving you scope to contribute ideas and improve how things are done.
Projects vary, so you’ll gain exposure to different technical challenges across web, mobile, APIs, databases and cloud-based environments.
You’ll be trusted to investigate problems properly, communicate risk clearly, and follow defects through to resolution.
Structured training, development and long-term career progression will support you in expanding your technical capability.
You’ll join a stable, growing business with a supportive culture that recognises ideas, initiative and achievement.

What You Need:

A strong understanding of QA methodologies and the software testing lifecycle.
Hands-on experience of both manual and automated testing across web, mobile and/or API environments.
The ability to create structured test cases and communicate defects and test outcomes clearly.
Experience managing test plans and defects within a modern software development workflow.
SQL knowledge for database validation and testing.
Experience working within an Agile or Scrum environment.
Familiarity with tools or technologies such as Jira, Postman, Selenium and AWS would be useful.

You don’t need to match every preferred technology listed above. If you have strong testing fundamentals, an investigative mindset and the appetite to broaden your skills, the company would still be interested in hearing from you.

Why You Should Apply:

If you enjoy investigating the unexpected, asking the questions others may miss, and helping teams release software with greater confidence, this could be an interesting next move for you.

Apply now or contact me for a confidential, no-pressure conversation to find out more.

At MIB our people are passionate about making roads safer by getting uninsured and hit-and-run drivers off our roads. Working in partnership with the Police, Insurers and Government our collective aim is to make it a thing of the past but, until that’s accomplished, we’re here to compensate victims quickly, fairly and compassionately.
Last year we helped more than 34,000 people struck by uninsured and hit-and-run drivers and paid over £400 million in compensation to support victims rebuild their lives.

About the role

Provide hands-on engineering, support and change delivery across MIB’s cloud, infrastructure and platform services. The role delivers second and third-line support, implements secure and recoverable platform changes, reduces technical debt, improves automation and ensures infrastructure services are stable, monitored, documented and supportable. Engineers are expected to work across BAU incidents, project delivery, lifecycle activity and continuous improvement, with clear evidence of testing, rollback planning and operational readiness for each change. Hands-on administration and engineering responsibilities for Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Entra ID, Intune, backup and recovery. The role should also support the controlled introduction of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform and Dynamics 365, including access controls, configuration, monitoring, documentation and operational support. Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams and Entra administration should be made essential, with Copilot, Dynamics, Power Platform and broader data and AI platform experience included as desirable skills.

Key responsibilities

Deliver second and third-line support for cloud, infrastructure, platform, endpoint and related Microsoft services.
Implement approved infrastructure changes, ensuring configuration, testing, rollback, documentation and evidence are completed.
Support patching, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, backup, capacity, lifecycle, access and configuration management activity.
Build and maintain repeatable infrastructure patterns using automation, scripting and Infrastructure as Code where appropriate.
Investigate incidents and problems, identify root causes and implement service improvement actions to prevent recurrence.
Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, diagrams and handover material for Service Desk and Service Management.
Support disaster recovery testing, backup validation, service continuity activity and technical control evidence.
Work with suppliers and internal teams to resolve escalations, track actions and maintain supportable service designs.
Provide extended technical support to the Service Desk where required, acting as an escalation point for cloud, infrastructure and Microsoft platform services, while enabling knowledge transfer, improving first-line resolution and supporting effective service request fulfilment.

Skills and Experience

Experience supporting Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, networking, endpoint, storage, backup or hybrid infrastructure services.
Practical understanding of monitoring, backup, patching, change control, incident/problem management, access control and operational documentation.
Experience with scripting, automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps tooling or configuration management desirable.
Ability to work within controlled change, release, testing and service transition processes.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across internal teams, vendors and service management processes.
Customer-focused mindset with a strong commitment to secure, stable, evidenced and supportable services.
Desirable experience includes SharePoint administration, Microsoft Dynamics and broader Microsoft 365 administration or support.

At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.
At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your role:
Engineer - IT Manufacturing Execution

As an Engineer at Elanco, you will be a key technical contributor to the digital heart of our production facilities. You will specialize in implementing and supporting our Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). This hands-on role is the critical bridge between our physical manufacturing processes and the digital systems that control and document them, ensuring our operations are efficient, compliant, and reliable.

This includes four strategic priorities:

Pipeline Acceleration: Optimize the search and approval of high impact medicines with a focus on speed, cost and precision.
Manufacturing Excellence: Improve the efficiency, quality and consistency of core manufacturing processes, specifically execution and equipment effectiveness.
Sales Effectiveness: Simplify the process to find, trust and consume relevant customer insights that drive sales growth and improved engagement.
Productivity: Expand operating margin through efficiency by systematically reducing our operating expenses across the company, improving profitability.

Your Responsibilities:

System Design and Configuration: Contribute to the design and be responsible for the configuration and implementation of MES solutions. This includes building and modifying electronic batch records (EBRs), system workflows, and configuring equipment integration based on defined requirements.
Process Optimization: Collaborate with operations and quality teams to analyze manufacturing and laboratory workflows. You will use MES capabilities to help implement process improvements, reduce production cycle times, and enhance data integrity at the shop-floor level.
System Management and Support: Provide frontline technical support for MES platforms. You will act as a key technical resource to troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring high availability for our manufacturing and lab teams.
Integration: Assist with the integration between MES and other critical systems, such as our ERP (SAP), and shop-floor equipment (PLCs/SCADA), ensuring a reliable flow of data.
Validation and Compliance: Execute validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) for MES enhancements and new implementations. You will be responsible for generating validation documentation and ensuring systems are maintained in a validated state, compliant with GxP and data integrity requirements.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Operations, Quality Assurance, and Process Science teams to gather system requirements and provide updates on technical activities.
User Training and Enablement: Develop training materials and conduct training sessions to ensure that manufacturing and lab personnel are proficient in using the MES/LES systems effectively in their day-to-day roles.

What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering (e.g., Industrial, Chemical, Manufacturing, Computer Science) or a related technical field or equivalent experience.
Required Experience: 3+ years hands-on experience with the configuration, and support of an MES platform (e.g., Tulip, Werum PAS-X, Emerson Syncade, POMSnet).
Manufacturing Environment Experience: Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biologics, animal health, or another GxP-regulated industry.
Regulatory Knowledge: A working knowledge of GxP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and familiarity with computer system validation (CSV) principles.
Process Control Understanding: Familiarity with industrial automation concepts, including PLCs, SCADA, and how they integrate with higher-level manufacturing systems.
Database and SQL Skills: Experience with SQL for data queries to support troubleshooting, data extraction, and report generation.

What Will Give You the Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to systematically diagnose and resolve technical issues.
Process Analysis: A solid understanding of business process analysis and workflow design. Ability to read and interpret process maps and requirements documents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment with operators, scientists, and management.
Cloud Platform Proficiency: Familiarity with Public Cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is a plus.
DevSecOps: Familiarity with the concepts of DevSecOps, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and source control (Git), is desirable.
Communication Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a technical team.

Our growing technology company is seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer with deep Azure expertise to help maintain the availability, performance, and reliability of our critical SaaS applications. Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting practices (e.g., Datadog, Azure Monitor, ELK stack), including hands-on troubleshooting with log analysis and stack traces using Datadog APM.
Familiarity with networking fundamentals: firewalls, load balancers, VPNs, DNS, and routing.
Experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, or similar).

Experience with AWS Cloud Platform.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps.

Prior experience operating SaaS products with regional tenant architectures (e.g., multiple geo-specific production environments).

jobs.description:
Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.
You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.
This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.
What you'll doAdvise on AI trust and governance. Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.
Scope and shape AI build projects. Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.
Build and deliver. Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.
Own the relationship through delivery. Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.
What we're looking forMust-haves 5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).
Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.
Machine Learning Expertise:
Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.
Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.
Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.
Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.

Strong pluses Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.
Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).
Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.
Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.
Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.
Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.

How we'll measure success Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.
Why this role, why now AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.

The Senior Engineer will create solutions that use artificial intelligence to solve real business problems, with AWS/Databricks as the core production platform and Claude and Codex supporting the engineering workflow. This is a hands-on role spanning discovery, software delivery and the reliable operation of live services

Responsibilities

Own the design, build, deployment and ongoing operation of production-grade AI-enabled data products on AWS and Databricks.
Work with stakeholders to define the user problem, measurable outcomes, data requirements and a pragmatic technical approach.
Prototype rapidly with Claude, Codex and other approved AI tooling, then turn successful concepts into secure, maintainable software.
Build reliable data pipelines, APIs and back-end services, together with front-end web or app experiences where the product requires them.
Apply strong software engineering practices including code review, automated testing, CI/CD, version control, documentation and infrastructure as code.
Create evaluation, monitoring and observability for data quality, model or LLM behaviour, service reliability, performance and cost.
Protect sensitive data and apply appropriate security, privacy, governance and responsible AI controls throughout the product lifecycle.
Operate and support live services, resolve faults swiftly, reduce technical debt and share practical knowledge with the wider team.

About the team

The Ecotricity Technology department is a small friendly team with a strong focus on getting results, with everyone committed to delivering both individually and as part of the group/project.

We have a training programme in place to further advance your skills, with dedicated learning time planned into our workloads. Relevant training and certifications, including Databricks and AWS, are supported by the company, alongside opportunities to deepen applied AI and software engineering skills.

We’re proud to be an ethical company, and this naturally attracts ethical people, making for a good safe working environment and a team that works and wins together. We also have a competitive benefits package and chose to invest in our people whenever we can.

About You

Are you an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business problems and data into useful, production-ready products? We are looking for a practical Senior Engineer who can take ownership from early discovery and prototyping through to deployment, adoption and support.

A leading organisation within the financial services sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's financial services and trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's financial services and trading platforms.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.
• Provide technical leadership across architecture, software development, data platforms, testing and system integration.
• Work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Oversee the development of applications, APIs, microservices and data platforms supporting financial services and trading.
• Establish and maintain strong engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment and documentation.
• Drive the adoption of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, cloud technologies and DevOps.
• Ensure close collaboration between developers, data engineers and QA throughout the development lifecycle.
• Help shape the long-term architecture and technology roadmap as the organisation continues its modernisation programme.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience leading an engineering function or large engineering team within a complex technology environment.
• Strong background in software engineering, ideally with experience across development, data engineering and QA
.
• Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices and data platforms.
• Experience with C#/.NET would be highly advantageous.
• Strong understanding of cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.
• Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
• Comfortable operating at both a strategic and technical level, with the ability to engage with engineers as well as senior business stakeholders.
• Experience working with complex data environments or high-volume, real-time systems.
• Financial services, capital markets, trading or commodities experience would be highly advantageous.

• A strong communicator who can provide clear technical direction while giving engineering teams the autonomy to deliver.

: Up to £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits
Location
: Paddington, London
Working Pattern
: 4 days per week in the office

Autodesk Education Experiences (AEX) helps students, educators, and institutions access Autodesk tools, learning programs, and certifications. Implement backend services APIs, integrations, and product infrastructure that support education product features and platform experiences
Move quickly from prototype to production, balancing speed, quality, maintainability, and user impact
Integrate and productize ML/AI solutions in close collaboration with digital experience and platform engineering teams
Build and maintain automation, plugins or SDKs for CAD platforms (e.g., Fusion, Revit, 3DS Max, Maya), including tooling to support reproducible experiments and product delivery

Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, researchers, frontend engineers, ML engineers, and platform teams to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features
Document designs, APIs, runbooks and hand-off materials to product teams, and help onboard other engineers to the codebase
Contribute to team culture by sharing knowledge, and promoting reproducible engineering practices

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent)
Strong experience with Full-Stack development workflows/processes and front-end familiarity (JavaScript, React/Next.js)
Able to utilise AI coding tools for increased velocity
Experience with containerization (Docker) and version control (Git)
Proven ability to integrate with CI/CD pipelines and maintain testable, maintainable code
Ability to work cross-functionally with product managers, designers, researchers, ML engineers, platform engineers, or other technical teams to ship
features
Strong debugging, problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in a distributed team

Experience working on CAD or 3D geometry systems (meshes, B-Reps, geometry kernels) or building plugins/automation for CAD platforms (e.g.,. Fusion, Revit, AutoCAD, Maya)
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and deploying/monitoring services in the cloud
Understanding of software architecture and design patterns for scalable systems
Experience translating prototypes, research ideas, or ambiguous product concepts into production-ready implementations
Prior exposure to education environments and the workflow of translating prototypes to product-ready implementations

Product-minded: You care about the user, the problem, and whether the thing you build actually works in the real world

jobs.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer specializing in .NET and frontend frameworks such as Angular/React, you will design and develop new features and enhancements across the full technology stack, with a strong emphasis on usability, performance, scalability, and security. 

You will own complex components end-to-end, contribute meaningfully to architecture and design discussions, and help translate business requirements into reliable, cloud-native solutions running in AWS. Your work will influence technical direction at the service and component level within a globally used flagship product. 

Responsibilities: 

Design and develop web applications based on microservice architecture, utilizing Angular/React and .NET technologies, with a focus on ease of use, performance, scalability, and security. 
Own complex components end-to-end, from requirements refinement and technical design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
Contribute to architecture, framework, database, and service design decisions, proposing improvements aligned with project goals, constraints, and platform standards. 
Build and maintain automated tests, quality gates, CI/CD pipelines, and code review practices to ensure secure, maintainable, high-quality delivery. 
Contribute to containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, while supporting production operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and preventive improvements. 
Collaborate with Product Owners, stakeholders, developers, IT, ML engineers, data analysts, and researchers in Agile Scrum ceremonies, while mentoring mid-level engineers and sharing best practices. 

What We’re Looking For: 

Key qualifications: 

Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
5–7+ years of software development experience, including delivery of web-based applications and cloud-native systems. 
Fullstack development experience with strong backend expertise in C# .NET Core, REST APIs, and familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React. 
Experience with microservices architecture, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Git workflows, automated testing, SQL databases, schema design, performant queries, and ORMs such as Entity Framework. 

Key soft skills: 

Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across development, IT, product, data, research, and engineering teams. 
Proactive, curious, and action-oriented approach to solving technical and business problems. 
Commitment to engineering excellence, security, maintainability, documentation, pair programming, and continuous improvement. 
Good spoken and written English, B2 level or above. 

Required Knowledge / Technologies: 

Proficiency in C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, RESTful services, and software engineering best practices. 
Practical experience with Angular/React and foundational knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for frontend integration. 
Docker, containerization, Kubernetes, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and cloud-native application design. 
Azure DevOps for planning, repositories, pipelines, and releases; Git-based version control and collaborative workflows including pull requests and code reviews. 
SQL databases, schema design, performant query writing, ORMs such as Entity Framework, automated testing, CI/CD, and quality gates. 

What’s in it for you: 

Engaging projects focused on building robust, scalable, secure cloud-based solutions in AWS. 
Close collaboration with experienced software developers, ML engineers, data analysts, and researchers. 
Opportunity to influence technical direction at the service and component level within a flagship product used globally. 
Corporate support for personal growth and career development, provision of all necessary equipment, and benefits including medical package, Multisport, life insurance, and the internal Wellbeing program.

Senior Principal Software Engineer (Backend/Full Stack)

Location:
Krakow, Poland (Hybrid)

Position Overview

Autodesk is expanding its engineering presence in Krakow and is looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer
(Backend/Full Stack) to help shape the future of our Smart Factory and Facility Operations platforms. While the target solutions are focused on Go (Golang) and React/JavaScript/TypeScript, we are open to candidates with experience in other technology stacks as well.

You will work across teams and disciplines to build our next-generation cloud web application platform – Tandem – that connects data and workflows across Industry 4.0, Industrial IoT (IIoT), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Digital Twin solutions.

This is a high-impact technical leadership (tech lead) role focused on driving platform strategy and architecture (partnering with experienced Autodesk senior architects) and delivering scalable cloud-native services that support mission-critical customer workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to influence technical direction, solve complex software engineering challenges, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on with design and development.

Join us in building software for people who design and make the world around us. From advanced manufacturing, sustainable buildings and resilient infrastructure to media experiences, Autodesk empowers innovators to solve complex challenges through technology.

Own the end-to-end delivery of major web application initiatives, from technical strategy and system design through implementation and operational excellence.
Design and build scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-native services that support high-volume production workloads – with a focus on backend services while contributing to frontend development when needed.
Partner with Autodesk Architects and Engineering Leaders to define and drive the technical vision and architecture for critical platform services.
Contribute hands-on to software development across full-stack technologies with a focus on Go/C++ backends and React frontends (flexibly adapting to other technologies where appropriate)
Establish engineering standards, architectural patterns, and best practices that improve platform quality, reliability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering leaders to align technical investments with business objectives.
Guide teams through complex technical challenges, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery goals.
Lead design reviews, provide technical mentorship, and elevate engineering excellence across multiple teams.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Champion operational excellence through observability, automation, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement practices.
Participate in Agile planning and execution activities while helping teams continuously improve delivery practices.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale commercial software systems.
Strong experience designing distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native web applications and APIs
Proven experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex software platform initiatives spanning multiple teams
Deep expertise in software engineering, with strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Go (Golang), C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, C#, Python, Java or similar (experience with Go and C++ is particularly valued)
Experience with any modern cloud platform such as AWS (preferred) or Azure.
Strong understanding of data architecture and database technologies.
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery practices.
Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with industrial and manufacturing domains (design, simulation, digital twin, operations), Smart Factory/Industry 4.0 solutions, Industrial IoT (IIoT), facility operations, asset management, AEC etc.
Experience with WebGL, 3D visualization technologies and micro-frontends.
Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and cloud observability practices.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
