jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100348

Senior Full Stack Software Development Engineer

Krakow, Poland

Position Overview

Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADSK) makes software for people who make things. We are a global leader in design and make software for the architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, and media and entertainment industries. If you have ever driven a high-performance car, admired a towering skyscraper, used a smartphone, or watched a great film, chances are you have experienced something created by millions of Autodesk customers using our software.

At Autodesk, we exist to turn ideas into new realities that shape a successful future. Our software and services harness emerging technologies—including additive manufacturing (3D printing), artificial intelligence, generative design, and robotics—to give companies and individuals the power to work more quickly and sustainably throughout the entire project lifecycle.

Autodesk Operations Solutions is developing a cloud-first platform that unifies facility operations, asset management, maintenance, process improvement, and building systems data, connecting the entire building lifecycle with day-to-day operations.

Central to this platform is Autodesk Tandem, which provides an ecosystem that transforms building and asset data into digital twin–based operational workflows and services. The solutions we are developing will build on this foundation through a modern web experience, a common information model, published APIs, and standardized connector patterns. These capabilities will enable customers and partners to integrate OT, IT, and CMMS systems, extend functionality, and operationalize analytics and managed services at scale.

We are expanding our presence in Kraków, Poland, and are looking for a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help shape the future of Autodesk Operations Solutions and Autodesk Tandem. Reporting to a Software Engineering Manager, you will contribute to delivering solutions that provide a cohesive, scalable cloud platform experience. The ideal candidate will have experience across all aspects of cloud application development.

Experience applying event-driven architecture principles

Experience with AI-assisted software development tools and practices
Experience with Agile methodologies and working within a Scrum framework
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities, technology stacks, and programming languages
A strong willingness to learn and develop new technical skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team

Design, develop, and support complex software applications, data pipelines, and cloud-based solutions.

Develop and optimize ETL processes and large-scale data processing solutions using modern Big Data technologies.

Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends and recommend improvements to products, services, and development processes.

Our culture promotes autonomy and collaboration, empowering individuals to thrive within self-organising teams. Our work involves processing and analysing a wide range of patient-level healthcare data, which supports solving complex healthcare challenges — from retrospective clinical studies to disease progression modelling.

In your daily activities, you will collaborate with a team of Architects who design effective solutions, and with the Development team, which ensures the highest standards of software.

The Data

We process over a billion records at a time, our engineers are responsible for the data analysis and construction and optimization of data flow processes. jobs.title: Associate Sales Engineer II
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold “what if.”

What if
your ideas could ignite global innovation?
What if
your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your
career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect 70% of the Fortune 500
, and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary: Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honors three years running
— and what we build is world-class: recognized as CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024
—evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if
the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.
In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox
.

Associate Sales Engineer - German/French/Italian/Spanish/Dutch speaker

We have an opportunity for a highly motivated and technically curious Associate Sales Engineer, fluent in German/French/Italian/Spanish/Dutch, to join our dynamic Enterprise Sales Engineering team in Warsaw, reporting to the Manager of Sales Engineering for the region. In this role, you will work closely with experienced sales engineers and account executives to support the sales process and help customers understand the value of Infoblox solutions. You will also learn all aspects of the sales process and participate in Infoblox global technical training programs.

Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do

Assist in delivering technical presentations and product demonstrations to prospective customers
Support the development of proof-of-concepts / values (POC/Vs) of Infoblox solutions
Collaborate with pre-sales solutions architects to gather customer requirements and map them to Infoblox’s offerings
Leverage defined pre-sales tools in customer engagements and supporting pre-sales solutions architects
Help respond to RFPs, RFIs, and other technical documentation requests
Learn and maintain a solid understanding of our DDI, DNS security, and cloud networking solutions
Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms (including internal Copilot-style solutions) to accelerate technical discovery, tailor demos and POCs, analyze customer environments, and clearly articulate the value of Infoblox’s AI-driven networking and security capabilities
Participate in discovery calls and meetings to understand customer environments and challenges
Contribute to the creation of technical documentation, solution diagrams, and sales collateral
Enable partner technical sales teams on Infoblox solutions and positioning to customers

Be Prepared — What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role for a technology organization
Interest in networking, cybersecurity, or cloud technologies
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Practical AI fluency, with the ability to confidently use AI-assisted tools for technical analysis, demo preparation, solution design, and customer conversations, understanding both the capabilities and limitations of AI in enterprise networking and security contexts
Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing
Fluency in English with German
Ideally some familiarity with Infoblox products or similar technologies or experience with networking labs, cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, or scripting, such as Python or Bash

Be Successful — Your Path

First 90 Days:
Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work
Six Months:

Have a foundational knowledge of our product/solution portfolio
Demonstrate fluency with either on-prem or SaaS-based Infoblox solutions
Identify 1-2 specialisation areas
Capable of handling primary SE customer-facing tasks with help from others

One Year:

Demonstrate fluency with all Infoblox solutions
Capable of handling advanced SE customer-facing tasks with only occasional help from others
Go-to person for specialisation area for the assigned region

Belong —
Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.
Be Rewarded —
Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

Ready to Be the Difference?

Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.

For this role based in Poland, the initial salary range is PLN 133,700 - 194,810 based on objective, gender-neutral criteria. Where a candidate is placed within this range is determined using those criteria, including skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market. This position is also eligible for the sales commission plan and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, where applicable to the role and consistent with the relevant company plans and local law. Employees are also eligible for company-sponsored benefits, which may include health and wellness benefits, retirement programs, paid time off, and other locally applicable offerings.
If you are assessed at a different level than the one advertised during the recruitment process, we will provide the salary range for that level promptly, to ensure you can make an informed decision.
We do not ask candidates about their current or previous compensation.

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100672

We are seeking an Principal Solution Architect to lead the evolution of Autodesk Consulting’s Intellectual Property platform as an enterprise-ready SaaS product powered by knowledge architecture, AI-enabled capabilities, and future agentic applications.

Working across product, engineering, architecture, and consulting teams, you will design the knowledge architecture that connects workflows, data, decisions, and insights across the AEC, MFG, and M&E domains. You will establish the semantic models, knowledge graph capabilities, and platform architecture required to support organizational change management, workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications.

This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Sr. Manager, Architecture.

Responsibilities

Define and evolve the architectural vision for Workflow Advisory and related knowledge-driven platform capabilities
Design semantic architectures, knowledge models, and knowledge graph capabilities that connect workflows, data, decisions, and insights
Define architecture patterns that enable workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications
Establish standards for knowledge representation, lifecycle management, governance, and reuse across platforms
Translate business workflows into reusable domain models, services, and architectural patterns
Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native architectures that support enterprise and customer-facing solutions
Ensure platform services, APIs, and knowledge assets are discoverable, composable, and consumable by AI-enabled applications
Apply AI and LLM technologies to improve knowledge discovery, workflow execution, and advisory experiences
Collaborate with architects and engineering responsible for ensuring architecture meets enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and SOC2 requirements
Collaborate with product, engineering, and consulting teams to align architecture investments with business outcomes and technology strategy
Drive adoption of architectural standards and reusable platform capabilities across teams
Mentor engineers and architects while communicating architectural direction to senior leadership and stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of experience designing and delivering complex software platforms
Experience as a Software Architect, Product Architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent technical leadership role
Experience designing AI-enabled, knowledge-driven, or workflow-centric software systems
Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, ontologies, taxonomies, graph databases, or retrieval systems
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG architectures, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agent patterns
Experience leading technical spikes, rapid prototyping efforts, or proof-of-concept development
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices
Experience designing secure, privacy-conscious, and trustworthy software platforms that operate within enterprise governance requirements
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 15% of the time is required

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Poland based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 238,000 PLN and 348,700 PLN. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Sales Careers

Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/careers/sales

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

jobs.title: Backendutvecklare .NET/Azure till prisbelönt digitalbyrå
jobs.description:
Att vakna på morgonen med längtan att gå till jobbet!

Vi har ett mål att alla som jobbar hos oss ska trivas så mycket att man vaknar med ett leende på måndag morgon. Vi är kanske inte Sveriges bästa bolag inom alla punkter men vi är Sveriges näst bästa bolag enligt Great Place to Work 2020. Vi tror att det beror på vår energi och nyfikenhet, vårt sätt att välkomna olikheter och våra erfarenheter som vi gärna delar med oss av.

Rebel and Bird är ett av B3s dotterbolag som tar hand om kunders önskemål och krav och förädlar dessa till flerfaldigt prisbelönta tekniska lösningar. Du blir inte nedbunden i gamla tekniker utan får möjligheten att jobba med det senaste inom backend och utvecklas med oss varje dag. Vårt absolut tydligaste mål med verksamheten är att alla ska ha kul på jobbet. Det låter som en plattityd men det är vårt stora mål. Vi försöker (när så går) att träffas och göra roliga saker utanför arbetstid någon gång i månaden utöver julfest, sommarfest och konferenser.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer arbeta både i interna och externa åtaganden, dvs i våra egna produktutvecklingsteam där vi tar helhetsgrepp på våra kunders önskemål, från koncept till UX och publicerad webb samt ibland på konsultbasis i våra kunders team. Vi har i dagsläget tre större åtaganden men en hel del mindre inhouse-projekt och externa konsultåtaganden. Här är två större inhouse-åtaganden:

Parks and Resorts - Vi utvecklar hela webblösningen inhouse i samarbete med kundens redaktörer och produktägare för samtliga parker. Den tekniska plattformen utvecklas med contentful/gatsby och .NET/Azure. Vi har blivit uppmärksammade nationellt för detta arbete, dels med ett silver i Svenska Designpriset 2019 för Kolmården, en nominering i Svenska Designpriset 2020 för Gröna Lund (prisutdelningen har ännu inte skett så vi vet inte var vi landar) samt Kolmården seger i IDG topp-100 för bästa turismsajt.
Filmstaden - Har du bokat/köpt biobiljett? Kanske inte på sistone men innan året som gud glömde gjorde du antagligen det har du använt vår lösning. Vi ansvarar för all extern webb samt vissa interna delar. Med denna sajt vann vi IDG topp100 2018 (då SF Bio). Webben utvecklas i en episervermiljö med .NET och Azure.

Vi tror att du har:

Ca 5 års erfarenhet av att arbeta skarpt som utvecklare. Det är viktigt att du arbetat i enterprise-projekt med webb för många slutanvändare.
.NET och Azure-kompetens

Det är meriterande om du har:

Kapacitet att ta tead-roll i våra projekt.
Kompetens inom Episerver och Contentful-erfarenhet, Xamarin
Erfarenhet som konsult

Vi erbjuder

Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats som kommer erbjuda distansarbete även när pandemin är över. För dem som vill jobba från kontoret på Sveavägen är det bara att komma in och jobba, dem som föredrar distansarbete kommer jobba primärt hemifrån men vara på kontoret 1-2 dagar i veckan i alla fall av primärt sociala skäl. Vi vill inte bara vara en namnlista på Slack. Utöver den naturliga komptensutvecklingen som sker av att arbeta i team med likasinnade erbjuder vi både externa och interna utbildningar. Vi startar exempelvis ett nytt initiativ vi kallar Kompetensnätverk - Från utvecklare till arkitekt, där en av våra lösningsarkitekter guidar dem som vill mot mer kunskap inom arkitektur för att förbereda dig för en roll som lösningsarkitekt om du så önskar.

Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på B3 och Rebel and Bird och hur vi arbetar med wellness och våra sociala initiativ här

Klicka på ansökan eller tveka inte att kontakta Jocke Ginsburg på telefonnummer: 073-8133010 eller email: jocke@rebelandbird.com

jobs.description:
Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.

What You'll Do

Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap

Who you are

You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.

You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments

Fluent
Swedish and English are both required for this role.

Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.

What You'll Gain

You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.

Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback

What this job actually looks like

Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require
. You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.

The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.

Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.

Why Intric

One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously

Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.

The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.

At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

About the AI Hub

The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.

We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.

The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

The role

Your users are your colleagues.
You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.

This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.

Some examples of what is already live
This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.

Our technology stack

Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.

The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What success looks like

Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.

By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

Why join CatalystOne?

This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
Build solutions that create visible business impact.
Work directly with the people using what you build.
Shape how the AI Hub develops.
Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.

Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to CatalystOne on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Overview

The GBS Capability Optimisation and Automation (GCOA)
organisation is a strategic function focused on transforming finance operations through intelligent automation and AI. GCOA acts as a centralised capability hub, enabling scalable, secure, and compliant solutions that deliver measurable business value.  

GCOA partners with finance and technology teams to:   

Identify automation opportunities.  
Design innovative solutions.  
Embed automation as a core enabler of operational excellence and digital transformation.  

Position Description

The Automation engineer role (P1-P3) will design and build end-to-end automation solutions for Lilly’s global Finance organization working across our full stack platform. The solutions will primarily be built on a platform consisting of a next.js React frontend with Python and PostgresSQL backend hosted on AWS that will interact with Lilly’s AI Platform (NLM and OCR use cases), Microsoft Fabric (PySpark, Delta Lake), SAP API, Graph API and additional systems APIs where necessary.

The primary objective of the team is to develop and deliver automation solutions and other emerging technology solutions for the Finance organization globally. 

Responsibilities

Partner with analyst team to review business opportunities and assessing solution feasibility. 
Participate in various types of interviews, meetings or workshops to define, design and configure solutions. 
Use technology to solve problems concerned with business strategy, organisation, procedures & performance and present findings. 
Analyses and interprets information gained and makes recommendations to business partners and analyst team.
Develop solutions in accordance with team standards and best practices. 
Create architecture and design documents as part of development process. 
Create and document test procedures and scenarios prior to launching User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
Conduct validations with team and business during the development of the project. 
Support business teams in testing activities, including integration testing, end-to-end (business process) testing and UAT. 
Support BAU team when necessary to problem-solve issues that arise in day-to-day running of automation processes.
Participate in the problem identification/error resolution process, including tracking, repairing and reporting defects. 
Communicate any identified and potential risks and issues to leadership team accordingly and provide actionable inputs to mitigate.
Support QA, audit activities and platform migration activities as needed. 

Experience

5+ Years of programming experience with systems and applications of varying scope and complexity. Preferably finance and supply chain business processes.
Experience with the following technologies: Python, PySpark, TypeScript JS, PostGresSQL.
Bachelor’s degree in Business/Management Information Systems or Computer Science or similar related field.
Ability to work independently, or in groups, sometimes as lead technical participant. 
Ability to take on complex assignments and assume increasingly greater responsibilities. 

Additional Preferences

Experience with Microservices architecture for modular and independently deployable components.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration, to enable streamlined deployment and scaling processes.
Experience with building system interactions through APIs, SAP being most preferable.
Experience with SAP, MS Fabric (PySpark notebooks, Delta Lake/OneLake), PowerBI, SharePoint Online. 
Exposure to GenAI platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic etc).
Experience in analysing, debugging, and refactoring legacy code.
Exposed to applying statistical concepts and data-quality/anomaly-detection techniques (e.g outlier or threshold-based checks) to business data.

Behavioural Skills

Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
An understanding of workflow-based logic; ability to both understand a business process from a workflow diagram or procedural documentation. 
Ability to prioritize, schedule and complete development and testing required for multiple applications with overlapping schedules. 
Experienced in supporting/training more junior team members.
Strong verbal and written communications skills.

Help Shape How Cities Are Designed

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us in developing the next generation of our AI-powered architecture design platform. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the quality and capability of our product. You'll work on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.

Your work will enable architects, planners, and developers to discover smarter, more sustainable solutions and gain meaningful insights into their projects.

About Us

We’re on a mission to help design better cities.

With 90% of future population growth expected in urban areas, and construction responsible for around 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. Our cloud-based Autodesk Forma platform helps users evaluate design choices based on environmental impact, living quality (sun, daylight, noise), and project feasibility. We started as Spacemaker in Norway and became part of Autodesk in 2020.

Learn more about Autodesk Forma here.

We work in small, autonomous teams with a high degree of trust and ownership. We strongly believe in servant leadership and team accountability. In each team, software engineers work closely together with product managers and designers. To learn more about our way of working, read through our tech and product core beliefs.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will deliver high-quality work and contribute to technical decisions within your team, while increasing your impact through ownership of complex features and systems.

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.

The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.

At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

About the AI Hub

The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.

We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.

The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

The role

Your users are your colleagues.
You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.

This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.

Some examples of what is already live
This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.

Our technology stack

Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.

The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What success looks like

Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.

By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

Why join CatalystOne?

This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
Build solutions that create visible business impact.
Work directly with the people using what you build.
Shape how the AI Hub develops.
Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.

Contribute to the design and evolution of systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI-driven capabilities
Drive high-impact technical initiatives and help align engineering efforts with broader product and business goals
Navigate trade-offs between performance, cost, and user experience in complex workflows

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to grow and develop talent across our organization in our AI-powered architecture design platform. Recognized as a skilled engineer who writes and ships code regularly

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Experience in an engineering manager, team lead, or similar people-leadership role

Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people leadership
Strong communication skills, especially in one-on-one coaching and feedback conversations
Experience with Agentic AI

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Track record of mentoring and developing engineers into stronger contributors
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser
Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100046

Join Autodesk in Oslo as a Software Engineering Intern in Summer 2027

At Autodesk Oslo, we develop next-generation, AI-powered architecture design tools. Our teams build everything from advanced 3D web drawing to real-time analytics powering multiple Autodesk products. As a summer intern, you'll build software that helps shape the Forma Industry Cloud for the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.

About Us

We're on a mission to help design better cities. With 90% of future population growth expected in cities and construction responsible for 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. We're building a new generation of cloud-based software that helps architects, urban planners, and real estate developers design sites and buildings in a new way.

Our Forma Design applications focus on outcome-based design, helping users weigh living quality (sun, daylight potential, noise, etc.), environmental impact (embodied and operational carbon), and profitability so they can find smarter, more sustainable solutions for their projects.

How we work

We work in small, autonomous teams that own their work and decide how best to build it. Engineers, product managers, and designers work side by side, collaborating across functions and time zones. We're an agentic-first organization, so working alongside AI tooling is part of how every team operates.

What you'll do

Over the summer, you'll work on a project that matters to your team, supported by experienced engineers. Your work is meant to ship and reach customers.

As a Software Engineering Intern, You'll

Contribute code to our in-market product, used by architects, urban planners, and real estate developers worldwide

Own a meaningful project from idea through to a working result, with guidance from your team

Gain hands-on experience across a wide range of technologies, from web-based 3D frameworks to large-scale systems and cloud computing

Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve customer problems
Take part in code reviews, design discussions, and the day-to-day work of an engineering team

We invest in your growth from day one. You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product managers, building your skills in a supportive environment. You'll also work directly with AI-powered tools as part of how we build software.

Beyond your project, you'll be part of the wider team, joining meetups, workshops, and hackathons, and getting a genuine feel for what a career in engineering at Autodesk looks like.

Who should apply

This internship is for students who want to spend their summer building software with a supportive team.

Currently studying computer science, software engineering, or a related field (preferred), ideally in your penultimate year, though we welcome strong students earlier in their studies too

Solid coding fundamentals from coursework, projects, or earlier internships
Curious, collaborative, and comfortable taking initiative and working independently
Comfortable breaking down problems and delivering practical solutions
Motivated by our mission to design better, more sustainable cities
Eligible to work in Norway

Practical details:
Paid internship

Full-time over summer 2027
On-site in our Oslo office
Applications close end of September 2026

We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. For us to review your application, you must upload your CV, relevant diplomas/certificates, and academic transcripts in PDF format.

Even if you feel you don't check off all the items on the list, we still encourage you to apply. Kindly note that applications must include a cover letter and a CV to be considered.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience, educational level, and geographic location.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our international development team.

We are a dynamic multidisciplinary group, passionate about creating solutions to advance adaptive radiotherapy for the benefit of cancer patients world-wide. Our passion is putting state-of-the-art software design and technology in service of advancing cancer treatment.

Domain Driven Design is the backbone of our design thinking, elements of the Microservices style drive the deployment. The Event Driven Architecture style and CQRS are means of achieving the right decoupling.

As a member of an agile team working on Varian's next generation treatment management system, you will participate in the full software development lifecycle from design and implementation to production deployment and operation support.

In addition, we offer ample opportunities to develop innovative solutions in the clinical domain.

We are looking for someone with strong development skills, passion for modelling and sustainable design and web development experience.

In addition, you are an open minded, adaptable thinker who will thrive in collaborative environments and value diverse perspectives.

We are developing a mission critical system, thus your commitment to safety and quality is a must.

As Senior Software Engineer, you will also be involved in the design of the software architecture, including defining interfaces, data flow, and integration strategies leveraging modern technology stacks.

You will collaborate with the Product Management and System Architecture teams to leverage emerging technologies, including Generative AI, to enhance the development cycle and enable modernization of the existing software.

Ethos Adaptive Therapy

What Will Set You Apart

Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and distributed system design.
Experience applying Generative AI to software development.
Experience in software architecture and the design of distributed software systems.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
A passion for innovation and continuous learning.

Your Role

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
In-depth knowledge of software engineering and experience using C#/.NET or another object-oriented language.
Experience in software development of distributed, service-oriented systems.
Web UI and cloud development experience, using Angular or similar framework.
Fluency in English language, both written and verbal.

Any Of The Following Is a Plus

Experience with virtualization and containerization.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with automation and scripting, such as PowerShell or Ansible.
Knowledge of current containerization and orchestration technologies in a Linux environment, including Kubernetes, Docker, and networking stacks.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards, such as DICOM and DICOM networking and safety-critical software development.

Who we are
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work
: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

Data Privacy
: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

Beware of Job Scams:
Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

To all recruitment agencies
: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Product Engineer - Construction
jobs.description:
Help shape how AI and human engineering come together to build market-leading software for the construction industry.

Are you a hands-on developer who understands both the technical and customer sides of great software? Do you want to work at the frontier of AI-assisted development, guiding both engineers and AI agents to deliver real value for our customers?

Then you might be our new Product Engineer!

As part of the department

You will join EG's Construction R&D organisation, working on Jydacom, ERP platform used across the construction industry. You will report to Timo Valonen, Senior Manager, Construction R&D management, and work closely with developers, AI agents, Product Owners, and Product Managers on a daily basis.

Most of the development team is in Mangaluru, India, while your Finnish colleagues and stakeholders are based in Jyväskylä. English is the primary working language across the team, but fluent Finnish spoken and written is required to work closely with local stakeholders. The role is based in our Jyväskylä office.

The Role

What You'll Be Doing

Gather and translate customer requirements into technical solutions.
Deliver the final software product full-stack — from frontend to backend and beyond to production deployment and monitoring.
Ensure the whole path of quality from unit testing to production monitoring.
Implement features and initiatives according to the product roadmap.
Take ownership of internal tooling development.
Also contribute to DevOps practices alongside the engineering team, helping maintain strong operational capability.
Work closely with an Indian development team, leveraging AI in the development process.
Collaborate primarily with internal stakeholders across the organization.
Turning complex business logic into simple, elegant technical solutions.

What You Bring

We care more about what you can do than what your CV looks like. Here's what will set you up for success:

Must-have

Senior-level background as a software developer, with +5 years of experience.
Experience with modern web development, REST API.
A production delivery mindset — you build production-ready solutions designed to last.
Understanding of how to build sustainable software products that meet customer needs in time while maintaining high technical quality.
Experience delivering solutions fulfilling non-functional technical requirements like maintainability, performance, security, observability.
Strong collaboration skills and willingness to work in an international environment.
Fluent written and spoken English and Finnish.

Nice-to-have

Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining systems with extensive third-party integrations and complex data models.
Hands-on development experience with Angular, TypeScript, .NET, and C#.
Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure, Power BI, and Fabric.
Familiarity with Windows server, IIS, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions.

What's in it for you?

Real ownership — Own the quality and consistency of what AI agents and developers deliver, with real influence over how our software is built.
Meaningful impact — Your work directly shapes a platform that construction companies rely on to run their business.
Growth mandate — Build on an established engineering foundation, and help shape how we combine AI and human expertise going forward.
AI-enabled leadership — AI agents are a core part of daily work, not an add-on, and you'll play a leading role in getting the best out of them.
Collaborative culture — Work closely with a Finnish and Indian team, in a Nordic culture built on trust and openness.

Our Values

Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

We look forward to hearing from you!

If you would like more information before you apply, please contact our Senior Manager, Construction R&D management, Timo Valonen, at timva@eg.fi or +358 40 5593685. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.

At EG, We Build Software That Makes a Difference

Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.

Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.

Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.

Curious what it's really like to work at EG?

Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG

jobs.title: Value Architect, Industry 4.0
jobs.description:
A senior industrial data and IT/OT expert who turns operational data into results, advising our key clients from strategy through delivery.

Do you enjoy working with industrial data and AI, where OT meets IT and data becomes operational results? Are you equally at home advising senior client stakeholders with a strategic vision and roadmap and, as lead architect, staying hands-on through the work that delivers it? If your answer is yes, then we are looking for you, Value Architect, to join our growing Data & AI Studio.

At Nortal, we build solutions and services that bring real value to users and society as a whole. In Finland, we have nearly 200 employees, and internationally we operate in over 20 countries. Our Data & AI Studio brings together strategy, engineering, and AI to help industrial enterprises turn operational data into results, bridging OT and IT from the shop floor to the cloud, and moving from discovery to scalable, production-grade solutions.

As a Value Architect, Industry 4.0 in our Data & AI Studio, you are a senior subject-matter expert and the trusted advisor industrial clients lean on to turn operational data into results. This is primarily a client-facing role. You work with senior stakeholders on where unified industrial data and AI turn cost into advantage, which investments return the most in uptime, quality, and decision speed, and which team should deliver them. You own the architecture across the IT and OT boundary and stay hands-on through delivery. A smaller part of the role helps the practice grow: you support presales when your expertise is needed, feed what you learn back into our industrial offering, and now and then share it through talks and writing. One morning you frame the business case with a VP of operations. That afternoon you review an edge-to-cloud architecture with the engineers who will build it.

The offering you will work with

Our work in this space turns industrial data into operational results. Most industrial enterprises want to scale AI but cannot, because fragmented OT and IT systems and inconsistent data quality leave them without a foundation to build on. We fix that first.

You take the lead on engagements like our Industrial Data & AI Kickstart and the platform and use-case work that grows out of it. You own them as the lead architect: facilitating the workshops, conducting a significant share of the analysis and design yourself, and bringing in specific experts, from IT/OT and cloud to integration and data and AI, where deeper specialism is needed.
This is operations-first work. It runs from the shop floor to the cloud, bridges OT and IT, and is grounded in real operational needs rather than slideware. You start here, sharpen the offering as you run it, and help shape what comes next.

What You Will Do

This is primarily a client-facing role.

Advise clients and protect the value
Be the trusted advisor.
Work with senior client stakeholders (heads of operations and manufacturing, plant and maintenance leaders, CDOs and CIOs) to connect their priorities to data and AI outcomes, and shape strategies and roadmaps they can act on.
Run the Kickstart.
Lead the discovery and design workshops, assess the as-is OT and IT landscape, and produce the edge-to-cloud target architecture, the governance and operating model, and the roadmap the client executes against.
Own the architecture.
Steer architecture and design decisions across the IT and OT boundary so solutions scale and stay governed, secure, and compliant. You need not ship every integration yourself, but you stand behind the design.
Stay through delivery.
Don’t hand off after the Kickstart. Stay hands-on through platform foundation and use-case pilots to protect the architecture, data governance, quality, and the value case into production.

Contribute to the offering and the practice
A smaller part of the role looks inward. You support presales when your expertise is needed, handle the hard technical objections, and help shape proposals and value cases. You turn what you learn on engagements into reusable patterns and proof points, and you share some of it through talks and writing. You mentor others and help run AI-aware delivery teams, so the practice grows beyond any one person.

What We Hope You Bring

A senior background in manufacturing operations management and industrial data with business acumen
(IT/OT or IIoT Architect, Industrial Data Architect, MES/MOM Lead, or similar), with ten or more years on the consulting or customer side.
Domain depth.
Working knowledge of more than one industry or industry type we serve is required, so you can speak the customer’s language from day one. Experience in both process and discrete industries, such as metals, forest, energy, packaging, chemical, or machine building, is especially welcome.
A track record of growing trusted client relationships
and turning advice into delivered work, with real ownership of the outcome rather than the handover.
Consultative mindset
. You lead with the customer’s operational problem, not with technology. You listen, frame the real question, and guide senior stakeholders to a decision they own. Enterprise architecture skills and experience are a strong asset here, connecting business strategy, operating model, data, and technology into one coherent picture.
Industrial platform familiarity
. Comfortable across the industrial stack, from shop floor to cloud: IT/OT integration, MES/MOM, process historians, edge and connectivity tooling, OPC UA and UNS architectures, data analytics over time-series data, and standards such as ISA-95/88. You are familiar with OT infrastructure, networking, and security, and with architecting containerized workloads at the edge. On the cloud side, you are comfortable with modern data stacks such as Azure IoT, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Applied AI.
Experience with machine learning solutions deployed in production (beyond PoC scope) for areas such as production, maintenance, quality, and warehouse optimization. GenAI solutions in production are a plus.
Communication.
Strong spoken, written, and presentation skills in Finnish and English, with the ability to reach shop floor engineers, enterprise architects, and operations leaders. German is an asset.
AI-first ways of working.
Comfortable using modern AI tools in your own work, with coding agents a plus. You work AI-first by habit, not by exception.

Why join us

Work where data meets the shop floor.
Real plants and real operations, from the Kickstart through to production, not perpetual pilots. You see the architecture you stand behind actually run.
A community, not a silo.
A multidisciplinary network behind you, from IT/OT, cloud, and integration architects to data and AI specialists, and delivery teams who can actually ship what you design.
Sell from strength.
Twenty-five years of industrial delivery, with experience in industrial digitalization dating back to 1987 and long-standing work with metals, energy, and forest clients. We are a Featured Microsoft Fabric Partner and one of the very few partners named in Microsoft’s Industrial AI Partner Guide.

Salary range:
5900-8800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

jobs.description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen

Sitecore & .NET Developer

Would you like to work with a broad portfolio of business-critical digital solutions? Twoday is looking for an experienced developer with strong Sitecore and .NET skills for a permanent position supporting an important area of the Danish public sector.

Sitecore will be a significant part of your work, but not your sole focus. We are therefore looking for someone who enjoys working across different solutions and technologies and is motivated by developing, maintaining and modernising a varied system portfolio.

Your Responsibilities

Develop and maintain Sitecore-based solutions
Contribute to broader backend development in C# and .NET
Develop integrations and REST APIs
Troubleshoot and improve existing business-critical applications
Contribute to technical design and modernisation initiatives
Write automated tests and participate in code reviews
Work with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
Collaborate closely with developers, testers and business stakeholders

Your background

Solid professional experience with Sitecore development
Strong hands-on skills in C# and .NET
Motivation to work with both Sitecore and other .NET-based solutions
Experience with integrations, REST APIs and relational databases
Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD
Experience with Azure and Azure DevOps is an advantage
Experience from complex enterprise or public-sector solutions is an advantage
Fluent spoken and written Danish
Able to work full-time onsite in Copenhagen

What we offer

At Twoday, you will join a strong professional environment focused on collaboration, knowledge sharing and technical quality. You will work with a varied system portfolio and have the opportunity to broaden your skills beyond Sitecore while contributing to meaningful digital solutions.

The position is a permanent role at Twoday, working full-time onsite with one of our public-sector customers in Copenhagen.

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. jobs.title: Senior SAP SD / Order-to-Cash Solution Architect - DK
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Freelance Senior SAP SD / Order-to-Cash Solution Architect

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior SAP SD / Order-to-Cash Solution Architect to support a global Life Sciences organization in governing and optimizing its SAP Order-to-Cash landscape.
The consultant will take ownership of the end-to-end SAP SD and Order-to-Cash domain, ensuring stable, scalable, and compliant solutions across multiple countries and business entities. The role combines solution architecture, process governance, business partnering, and hands-on SAP expertise, while supporting ongoing transformation initiatives and S/4HANA readiness activities.

Key Responsibilities

Own and govern the SAP SD and Order-to-Cash solution landscape, including order management, pricing, deliveries, shipping, billing, returns, and credit management.
Provide architectural guidance for incident resolution, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Design and maintain scalable global SAP solutions aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
Lead solution design activities across sales operations, customer service, logistics, and finance functions.
Drive SAP integration activities involving third-party logistics providers (3PLs), middleware platforms, EDI, APIs, and IDocs.
Support the design and implementation of e-invoicing and tax compliance solutions across multiple markets.
