jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a highly skilled architect who can turn complex commercial, digital, data and artificial intelligence choices into clear direction? Join Lundbeck as Commercial Domain Architect and help shape our commercial digital ecosystem.

In this role, you will be the design authority for the commercial digital domain across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled workflows. You will help create a coherent ecosystem that can scale across markets while balancing global consistency, local relevance, speed, flexibility and long-term sustainability.

Your new role

As Commercial Domain Architect, you will own and evolve the target architecture for Lundbeck’s commercial digital domain, translating commercial priorities into clear architectural direction across platforms, integrations, data and future capabilities.

A key part of your role will be navigating complex trade-offs where there is rarely one perfect answer — for example global standardisation versus local flexibility, platform-native versus modular approaches, and speed of delivery versus long-term scalability.

You will work closely with the Head of Architecture & Design, solution architects, commercial stakeholders, colleagues across data, artificial intelligence, security and operations, and external partners. You will be a trusted sparring partner for the solution architects, helping them navigate design choices, challenge assumptions and keep solutions aligned with the broader commercial target architecture.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Shape the commercial architecture

Own and evolve the target architecture across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities.
Define how customer, account, engagement, content, consent, insight and performance data connect across the commercial ecosystem.
Define platform boundaries, integration patterns and solution principles that enable interoperability, reuse and future flexibility across the organisation.

Provide strategic design authority

Act as the architectural design authority for the commercial domain and assess solution fit within agreed enterprise principles and guardrails.
Provide clear recommendations on strategic trade-offs and make the rationale understandable to both senior stakeholders and technical teams.
Identify and challenge designs that could create unnecessary duplication, technical debt, weak interoperability, vendor dependency or constraints on future scalability and innovation.

Enable data and artificial intelligence

Ensure the commercial architecture supports trusted, well-governed and artificial intelligence-ready data and insights.
Shape the architectural foundation for scalable artificial intelligence workflows and future artificial intelligence-enabled customer engagement.
Connect commercial architecture with wider enterprise capabilities across data, artificial intelligence, integration, security and operations.

Guide solutions from architecture to delivery

Act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects and guide external partners so detailed designs remain aligned with the commercial target architecture and agreed design principles.
Challenge technology and implementation partners on data models, integration, extensibility, compliance, scalability, vendor dependency and long-term cost.
Provide architectural recommendations and risk assessments that inform platform, vendor, investment and roadmap decisions.

Your future team

You will join the Architecture & Design team within Commercial Digital Enablement, part of Lundbeck’s Enterprise Digital Enablement organisation. The team connects commercial priorities with enterprise architecture and solution design, helping Lundbeck develop digital capabilities that can be reused and scaled across markets.

You will report to the Head of Architecture & Design. As Commercial Domain Architect, you will provide professional architecture authority for the commercial domain and act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects, the Delivery Lead and stakeholders across Commercial, Data, Artificial Intelligence, Security and Operations.

The position has no direct people-management responsibility, but you will have significant professional influence through your role as the architectural authority for the commercial digital domain.

The role is based at our headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Given the collaborative and leadership nature of the role, frequent in-office presence is required.

What You Bring To The Team

We are looking for a highly talented architect who combines strong technical judgement with commercial understanding, pragmatic decision-making and excellent communication skills. You bring:

8+ years of experience in domain architecture, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or senior platform roles.
Strong understanding of commercial capabilities within life sciences, including customer relationship management, customer engagement, customer and account data, and analytics.
Experience shaping target architectures and designing scalable digital ecosystems across multiple markets or business units.
Strong understanding of data, artificial intelligence, integration, platform architecture and governance.
Experience assessing platform and ecosystem choices and challenging technology vendors and implementation partners.
The ability to assess complex architectural trade-offs and advise senior stakeholders in practical business language.
A collaborative working style, with the ability to build trust and create alignment across business, digital, data, artificial intelligence and technology teams.
The confidence to act as a constructive sparring partner for solution architects, helping translate architectural principles into practical solution design.
A strong enterprise mindset, with the ability to balance local requirements with scalability, interoperability and long-term sustainability.

Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further in addressing the significant unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with exciting challenges and development opportunities, balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
About Apylon and the opportunity

Apylon is building agents for the most complex workflow out there - financial admin in healthcare.
Hospitals and payers move billions of euros through fragmented, manual workflows shaped by clinical data, payer rules, contracts, and local coding systems. We believe this is a data, machine-learning, and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

We are live with leading private hospitals and expanding quickly. Every hospital presents a different challenge: EHR systems are configured differently, national coding rules vary, and contracts describe the same clinical event in different terms. Your job is to help us turn that complexity into a system that learns: each new integration should make the next one faster, safer, and less expensive.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe. You’ll join the first small engineering team, with massive ownership over both what we build and how we build it.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

Own EHR integrations end to end: APIs, schemas, undocumented behaviour, operational failure modes, and vendor changes.
Build reusable integration-platform primitives for extraction, normalisation, versioning, replay, monitoring, and observability.
Design the canonical data model that connects heterogeneous EHR data, reimbursement systems, national coding standards, and hospital-specific conventions.
Build reliable inputs for our billing agents, including the constraints, validation, and evaluation systems that make model-assisted decisions safe to use in production.
Work directly with hospital IT teams and EHR vendors: technical discovery, implementation, joint debugging, and onboarding.
Take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work: design, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration from real-world data.

Who you are

3+ years building and operating production systems in complex, messy domains. We care more about demonstrated judgment and ownership than an exact number of years.
Experience using LLMs as production components—not just developer tools. You understand when to use models, when deterministic systems are better, how to constrain outputs, and how to evaluate reliability.
Strong data-modelling instincts. You know when abstraction creates leverage and when it hides important real-world variation.
Comfort working from incomplete information. You form hypotheses, test them against data, and distinguish unknowns that can wait from assumptions that could invalidate the system.
Confidence in customer-facing technical work: discovery calls, debugging sessions, and direct conversations with vendors and hospital IT teams.
Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
A practical, hands-on approach: equally comfortable designing an integration architecture and writing a quick script to answer an urgent question.

This role may be a strong fit if

You enjoy reverse-engineering systems you do not control, finding structure in messy real-world data, and turning one-off discoveries into reusable software. You are comfortable being the engineer in the room with customers and partners.

What this role is not

Consulting or bespoke delivery work. Each integration must improve the product and reduce the marginal cost of the next.
A role insulated from customers or operational reality.
Pure platform engineering or pure integration work: the value comes from doing both.
A role where incorrect mappings are merely technical defects. In this domain, they can produce incorrect invoices.

Bonus points

Experience with healthcare interoperability or coding standards, including HL7v2, FHIR, or national messaging and reimbursement standards.
Experience building and operating third-party integrations at scale.
Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated environment.
Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company.
Working proficiency in Danish, or German.

Our tech stack

Python · Django · React · PostgreSQL · AWS · K8s · Terraform · Bedrock
We’re pragmatic. You’ll have a big say in how it evolves.

What Apylon offers

The chance to solve one of Europe’s biggest healthcare inefficiencies.
Competitive salary + stock options (you’ll own part of what you build).
25 days of annual leave + local public holidays.
Lunch on us during workdays at the office.
Regular off-sites and social events. We like building together, not just working together.
Travel within the EU roughly monthly. Onboarding a hospital, working through an integration with a vendor’s engineers, or spending time on-site to understand how the data is actually produced. If travelling to a hospital basement to figure out why an export is malformed sounds like a bad week, this isn’t your role.

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code, powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue systems.

Functiebeschrijving

Als Senior .NET Application Architect versterk je een dynamisch Enterprise Architecture Team van 4 personen.

Je garandeert dat de architectuur van het IT-systeem en landschap blijft evolueren. Je helpt en ondersteunt de multidisciplinair samengestelde ontwikkelteams om kwaliteit op te leveren volgens de objectieven van de klant en het product management.

Je maakt de architecturale visie begrijpelijk en toepasbaar voor de teams. Je verduidelijkt de waarde en werking van modellen, standaarden en patronen. Ook ondersteun je bij de implementatie.

Concreet definieer je de applicatie- en integratie architectuur voor een volledige herschrijving van een belangrijke businesstoepassing in een Cloud gebaseerde omgeving. Je werkt mee aan de verdere uitbouw van een microservices-architectuur.

Profiel

Je beschikt over een Master of je kan gelijkwaardige ervaring aantonen. Je hebt minimum 10 jaar ervaring als hands-on .NET Application Architect en minimum 5 jaar ervaring in een Agile architectuur-omgeving (SAFe– Scaled Agile Framework).

Je hebt een aantoonbare ervaring in:

Applicatie architectuur in een .NET-omgeving met microservices
Opzetten en gebruik van Azure Cloud computing services, gRPC, Dapr, Azure SQL
Opzetten en gebruik van container oplossingen (bv. ACA, AKS)
NServiceBus
Architectuurframeworks en tooling (Domain driven design, event-based architecture, Sparx EA, DrawIO, …)

Kennis van Oracle PL/SQL is een voordeel.

Business kennis van het sociaal statuut van de zelfstandige is een pluspunt.

Je komt autonoom en verantwoordelijk tot resultaten.

Je kan strategisch sparren met C-level stakeholders en tegelijk pragmatisch schakelen met ontwikkelteams (ontwikkelaars, testers, ...).

Als teamplayer stimuleer je als servant leader co-creatie om tot een gedragen oplossing te komen.

Je drukt je vlot uit in het Frans en in het Engels.

Wij bieden

Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job
waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.
Zoek je een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven? Geniet van flexibele werkuren en maak gebruik van ons zeer uitgebreid telewerkbeleid
.
We bieden ruime interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor je je technische skills en persoonlijke vaardigheden voortdurend kunt aanscherpen.
We bieden je een competitief salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen
zoals hospitalisatieverzekering, aanvullend pensioenplan, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques,…
IT-functies kunnen rekenen op een mobiliteitsbudget
met de keuze voor een bedrijfswagen en/of terugbetaling openbaar vervoer. Onder bepaalde voorwaarden kan je dit budget zelfs gebruiken voor de betaling van je huur of hypothecaire lening.
Via ons 'Benefits at Work'-platform geniet je van mooie kortingen op mode, elektronica, daguitstappen, vakantieverblijven, …
We voeren een gelijkekansenbeleid
en vinden o.a. equal pay belangrijk.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor deze functie zoeken we een medior .NET-ontwikkelaar met een brede kennis van zowel klassieke als moderne technologieën. Je versterkt een productteam dat instaat voor de ontwikkeling, ondersteuning en verdere uitbouw van digitale toepassingen voor eindgebruikers.

Je werkt mee aan nieuwe functionele uitbreidingen, maar ook aan het onderhoud en de optimalisatie van bestaande webapplicaties. Samen met je collega’s neem je end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid op voor het realiseren van klantwaarde. Daarbij combineer je analyse, ontwerp, ontwikkeling, testing en ondersteuning binnen een Agile werkomgeving. De opdracht bestaat gemiddeld uit ongeveer twee derde projectwerk en één derde onderhoud en incidentopvolging.

Analyse en ontwerp

Je werkt mee aan functionele analyses en vertaalt businessvereisten naar technische oplossingen.
Je stelt technische ontwerpen op voor nieuwe functionaliteiten.
Je beoordeelt de technische haalbaarheid van nieuwe vragen en wijzigingsverzoeken.
Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere verbetering van applicatiearchitectuur en codekwaliteit.

Ontwikkeling en ondersteuning

Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en optimaliseert webapplicaties.
Je ondersteunt bestaande toepassingen binnen projectwerking, onderhoud en incidentbeheer.
Je realiseert uitbreidingen volgens functionele en technische vereisten.
Je onderzoekt incidenten en technische problemen en werkt duurzame oplossingen uit binnen de afgesproken servicelevels.
Je ondersteunt releaseactiviteiten en helpt mee aan een gecontroleerde uitrol van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

Kwaliteit en testing

Je bouwt kwalitatieve, performante en onderhoudbare software.
Je stelt unit tests op en voert ze uit.
Je ondersteunt integratie-, systeem- en acceptatietesten.
Je past ontwikkelrichtlijnen, best practices en IT-standaarden consequent toe.
Je documenteert analyses, ontwikkelingen en technische oplossingen zorgvuldig.

Samenwerking en werking

Je werkt nauw samen met product owner, analisten, ontwikkelaars, testers en andere stakeholders.
Je neemt actief deel aan Agile ceremonies zoals sprintplanning, refinements, reviews en retrospectives.
Je draagt bij aan kennisdeling binnen het team.

Change- en releasemanagement

Je past change- en releaseprocessen nauwgezet toe.
Je ondersteunt de voorbereiding, uitvoering en opvolging van releases.
Je bewaakt kwaliteit, risico’s en stabiliteit bij wijzigingen in productieomgevingen.

Jouw profiel

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met de ontwikkeling van .NET-gebaseerde toepassingen.
Je beschikt over uitgebreide kennis van en ervaring met .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET en Entity Framework.
Je hebt ervaring met federated authentication, waaronder SAML en OAuth.
Je hebt ervaring met Azure en met diensten zoals Azure API Management, Azure App Services, Azure Data Factory en Azure Service Fabric.
Je bent vertrouwd met webontwikkeling en courante front-end technologieën en frameworks, waaronder JavaScript en Angular 2 of hoger.
Je hebt ervaring met webservices zoals WCF, SOAP, Web API en REST.
Je kan werken met relationele databases, zoals Oracle en SQL.
Je hebt ervaring met unit testing.
Je bent vertrouwd met een Agile ontwikkelingsmethodiek.
Je voelt je thuis in een procesgestuurde organisatie en hebt voeling met ITIL-proceswerking.
Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete oplossingen.
Je werkt zelfstandig, gestructureerd en nauwkeurig, met een proactieve en resultaatgerichte ingesteldheid.
Je communiceert vlot, werkt graag samen en draagt actief bij aan een positieve teamdynamiek.
Je bent leergierig en bereid om nieuwe technologieën en domeinkennis verder op te bouwen.

Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. jobs.title: Azure Cloud Platform Architect
jobs.description:
About Devoteam:

Devoteam is a leading consulting firm focused on digital transformation. We help our clients leverage technology to achieve their business goals.

Our longstanding partnerships with leaders like AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and ServiceNow
amplify our capabilities, allowing us to deliver top-tier expertise and award-winning services. We complement these partnerships with in-depth Cyber, Data & AI, Software development and multi cloud expertise.

For 30 years, we have always been guiding our customers on the next tech wave
. Devoteam has guided organizations through the Internet and cloud. The next revolution? AI.

With 11,000 tech natives working in 25+ countries, we bring you highly skilled IT experts across Europe

At Devoteam, tech is in our DNA
, and it’s the people we empower with tech. Now, with responsible AI, we’re ready to unlock a future where technology drives positive change.

Job Description

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Azure Cloud Platform Architect
to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing robust, scalable, and secure cloud solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. You will play a pivotal role in our cloud strategy, working closely with development teams, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver innovative and efficient cloud infrastructure. ☁️

Key Responsibilities:

Design and Architect Azure Solutions: Develop and implement comprehensive cloud solutions across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS services, considering scalability, performance, security, and cost-effectiveness.
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements and communicate architectural decisions.
Cloud Strategy and Roadmap: Contribute to the development and execution of the overall cloud strategy and roadmap, aligning with business objectives.
Technical Leadership: Provide expert guidance and technical leadership to development and operations teams on Azure best practices, architecture patterns, and emerging technologies.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and implement IaC solutions using tools like ARM templates, Bicep or Terraform to automate and manage Azure resources.
Security and Compliance: Ensure all Azure solutions adhere to security best practices and relevant compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA). Implement robust security controls and monitoring. 🛡️
Support Sales: Technical support during RFI, RFP requests...
Migration and Modernization: Lead and support the migration of on-premises workloads to Azure, as well as the modernization of existing cloud applications.
Cost Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize Azure resource utilization to ensure cost efficiency.
Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Implement monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure high availability and performance of Azure services. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity: Design and implement disaster recovery and business continuity plans for Azure-based solutions.
Documentation: Create and maintain detailed architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and operational documentation. 📄
Stay Current: Keep abreast of the latest Azure services, features, and industry trends.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Proven experience as a Cloud Architect, Solutions Architect, or a similar role with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure.
In-depth knowledge of core Azure services, including:
Compute (Virtual Machines, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Services, Azure Functions)
Storage (Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Azure NetApp Files)
Networking (Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway)
Databases (Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL)
Security (Azure Security Center, Azure Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Active Directory)
Monitoring (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics)
Identity and Access Management (Azure AD, RBAC)
Hybrid Cloud (Azure Local, Azure Arc)
Cloud PC (AVD, Windows 365)

Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, including microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform).
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python).
Solid understanding of DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 💡
Strong communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Fluent in English and either French or Dutch, or both.

Desired Qualifications:

Microsoft Azure certifications, e.g. 🏅:
AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions,
AZ-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions,
SC-300: Identity and Access Administrator Associate,
AI-102, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate).

Experience with hybrid cloud environments.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Desktop/SDK)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our social media pages
to learn more about us: Twitter, Reddit, Instagram.

The role:

You will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining and evolving the sync SDK powering Proton Drive's desktop applications. This includes not only building the application internals (managing and syncing local and remote state, performing cryptographic operations, etc) but also helping us to build resilient, scalable applications (graceful degradation; log and metrics streams free of personally identifiable information). You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, but with a strong focus on the internals shared amongst our desktop applications, including Gitlab configuration, deployments, monitoring and alerting, and operational incident response. While this position is not a "full-stack" position, you will be expected to collaborate with backend engineers to drive any necessary changes and/or new features needed for the core of our desktop experience.

What you will do:

Be part of a small team working to bring a "privacy by default" solution to our Drive clients on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Develop applications that delight a wide range of users, from layperson to technical, and gives confidence that their online privacy is in good hands - while getting the complexity of end-to-end encryption out of the way.
Invest in test automation to improve the team's productivity and software delivery cadence.
Think critically on how to divide problems into iterations of simpler, composable solutions. Re-evaluate the minimum scope as necessary to meet objectives on-time.
Insist on high standards for application monitoring and alerting, in order to ensure a smooth customer experience at all times.

We are looking for:

Strong experience in .NET development
Strong experience with concurrent multi-threaded programming
Optional experience building and maintaining desktop applications
Working knowledge of file systems
Working knowledge of Git
Bachelor's or master’s degree in a relevant field of study
Experience with owning and maintaining large software components
Experience with gradual rollouts and metrics/monitoring/alerting frameworks

Even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed above, but feel you could still be a great fit, please still apply.

What We Offer

Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

Overview

Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Zurich to tackle hard product and platform challenges as VS Code and GitHub Copilot continue to reshape how developers build software.

You will help to evolve VS Code as a market leading developer environment, seamlessly connecting its editor, agentic coding abilities, platform and extension ecosystem. You will identify where investment matters, prove difficult ideas in code, and establish approaches that multiple teams can build on. This is hands-on technical leadership: the opportunity to change both what developers can accomplish and what our engineering teams can deliver.

About The Team

We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will partner with engineers, designers, researchers, and product leaders across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. We combine community feedback, research, experiments, and engineering judgment to decide what to build. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

Examples of work

The role spans core VS Code and Copilot; illustrative projects include:

Address architectural bottlenecks in large workspaces, proving an approach in code that multiple feature teams can adopt.
Define extension or workspace APIs that unlock new capabilities while preserving compatibility with existing extensions and remote development environments.
Prototype how developers delegate, review, and validate work with Copilot, then establish the product and platform boundaries needed to ship it.
Reshape and support our engineering process with custom solutions fine-tuned for throughput and quality.

Responsibilities

Identify significant product opportunities and systemic engineering problems; set technical direction that balances near-term delivery with long-term product and platform health.
Prove approaches through prototypes, critical implementation, testing, and difficult debugging, using hands-on work to guide architectural decisions.
Lead cross-team delivery across Microsoft and GitHub, resolving architectural disagreements, clarifying ownership and API boundaries, and enabling teams to deliver independently.
Own outcomes beyond release, using adoption, quality signals, evaluations, experiments, and user feedback to guide investment and adjust course.
Improve engineering effectiveness across teams through testing strategies, performance work, shared design patterns, and tools for rapid, reliable experimentation.
Lead technical discussions in the open, investigate community-reported issues, and work directly with developers and extension authors to shape designs.
Mentor experienced engineers and technical leaders, helping them develop judgment and take ownership without making yourself a bottleneck.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

Clear communication skills, including explaining complex technical decisions and navigating tradeoffs with engineering and product partners.

One team, One mission Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.

Accountable to our customers We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.
Excellence in execution Driven by passion and precision, we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.
Be bold, fail fast, learn faster We learn as we grow, dare to try, and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.

These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.

Why Nitro Engineering:

Engineering is a critical function at Nitro, developing the products and services at the heart and soul of our business today, and helping us realize our vision of smarter documents in the future. We have an incredibly talented and diverse Engineering team that cares, with a strong culture that believes in building the right things and building them the right way. 

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the team responsible for customer identity and access management (CIAM), as well as the acquisition and renewal stages of the customer journey. You will join the existing team and collaborate on delivering feature, security, scalability and resiliency enhancements to our existing Java and Scala code base. You will contribute to the design of new features. You will work cross-functionally with other Nitro Engineering teams and stakeholders to support the exciting enhancements coming to the Nitro cloud product suite.

Strong architectural thinking and ability to make strategic technical decisions that balance immediate needs with long-term sustainability
Strong knowledge of, and professional development experience with, a JVM based language

At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

new_jobs.description:
We vragen

Technisch leiderschap

Technisch zeer sterk

Eigenaarschap

De impact die je gaat maken als Architect .NET

Met de FORCE Product Suite (FPS)
en het Quion Service Platform (QSP)
bieden wij een end-to-end platform voor hypotheekverwerking. Deze oplossingen ondersteunen enkele van de grootste financiële instellingen van Nederland bij een van hun meest cruciale processen.

Deze functie biedt je de kans om architectuurkeuzes te maken die impact hebben op miljoenen hypotheekprocessen in Nederland. Je werkt samen met vooraanstaande financiële instellingen, ervaren architecten en gedreven ontwikkelteams aan platformen die essentieel zijn voor de Nederlandse hypotheekmarkt. Het platform is continue in ontwikkeling, zowel over de as van nieuwe proposities als de technische doorontwikkeling.

Bij Topicus krijg je de ruimte om richting te geven, te vernieuwen en daadwerkelijk het verschil te maken.

Wat je gaat doen als Architect .NET

Als Architect maak je deel uit van het Solution Architecture Team (SAT) en/of het Core Team. Je werkt nauw samen met productteams, stakeholders en klanten aan de strategische ontwikkeling van onze platformen. Je vertaalt businessdoelstellingen naar duurzame architectuuroplossingen en bewaakt de samenhang binnen een complex applicatielandschap. Daarbij heb je oog voor zowel business capabilities als technische architectuurprincipes, waarbij aspecten zoals security, performance, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid vanzelfsprekend onderdeel zijn van je afwegingen.

In Deze Rol

Ontwikkel en bewaak je de architectuurvisie en technologische strategie voor FPS en QSP.
Begeleid en coach je meerdere multidisciplinaire scrumteams in architectuurvraagstukken en technische besluitvorming.
Werk je samen met enterprise-architecten van toonaangevende financiële instellingen zoals ING, Rabobank en de Volksbank.
Zorg je ervoor dat nieuwe ontwikkelingen aansluiten op de doelarchitectuur en de langetermijnstrategie van het platform.
Prioriteer je samen met Product Owners technische en functionele initiatieven en creëer je balans tussen innovatie, onderhoudbaarheid en klantwaarde.
Stel je technologische roadmaps op en adviseer je stakeholders over risico's, kosten en strategische keuzes.
Signaleer je nieuwe businesskansen en vertaal je deze naar technische mogelijkheden binnen onze oplossingen.
Stimuleer je innovatie door actief nieuwe ideeën, technologieën en verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Je bent niet alleen richtinggevend op architectuurniveau, maar ook een verbindende factor tussen business, development teams en klanten.

Wat breng jij mee als Architect .NET

Bij Topicus geloven we dat mensen het beste presteren wanneer ze kunnen doen waar ze goed in zijn. Daarom zoeken we een architect die visie combineert met pragmatisme, anderen inspireert en techniek weet te verbinden met bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Je bent communicatief sterk, weet stakeholders mee te nemen in complexe vraagstukken en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar technologie en business nauw samenkomen.

Daarnaast Herken Je Jezelf In Het Volgende

Academisch werk- en denkniveau.
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Architect binnen een complexe enterprise-omgeving.
Aantoonbare kennis van .NET, Azure en cloud-native architecturen.
Sterk conceptueel denkvermogen en ervaring met het definiëren van business capabilities en domeingrenzen.
Diepgaande kennis van architectuurprincipes, integratiepatronen en softwareontwerp.
Ervaring binnen het financiële domein is een sterke pré.

new_jobs.description:
About Agile Defense

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #:
1858

Job Title:
Senior Application Security Engineer

Location:
Remote

Clearance Level:
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance

Job Description

Responsible for engineering and optimizing integrated systems that support enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. Develops comprehensive solutions that enhance system reliability, scalability, and security. Leads the evaluation of new technologies and system architectures, providing strategic recommendations to enhance organizational capabilities.

Education and Years of Experience

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, and 4+ years of experience, or equivalent relevant work experience; e.g., each year of work experience may be substituted for each year of education required.

Required Skills

Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
1+ year of experience with supporting Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and IDE Plug-in environments using Veracode .
2+ years of experience with Java, Python, .NET, or C#.
3+ years of experience using the design and implementation of enterprise-wide security controls to secure applications, systems, network, or infrastructure services.
Experience with Eclipse, JDeveloper, including pipeline development, or Visual Studio Experience with securing enterprise web applications and OWASP Top 10, CVSS, CWE, WASC, and SANS-25.
Knowledge of federal compliance standards, including NIST 800-53, FIPS, or FedRAMP.
2+ years experience working in Linux based environments, including navigating and troubleshooting basic website connectivity issues
Familiarity in Linux environment and some type of coding and/or scripting experience is a must.
The areas of focus for this role are Burp Enterprise experience performing DAST scanning.
Experience with Burp Professional, with focus on SAST scanning.
Veracode experience performing SAST scanning.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Interactive Application Security Testing (IAST) capabilities and tools.
Experience with HackerOne.
Experience with Selenium.
Experience writing bash scripts.
Experience with OWASP ZAP or Burp Proxy

$140,000 - $145,000 a year

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.

What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.

Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

new_jobs.title: Senior Developer D365 CRM (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
DEINE AUFGABEN.

Als erfahrene:r Dynamics-365-Entwickler:in gestaltest du unsere Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement Plattform aktiv weiter. Dabei übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Features von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live und bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für technische Fragestellungen im Team.

Du entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen in Microsoft Dynamics 365, darunter Plugins, Custom Workflow Activities und Power Automate Flows, nach etablierten Microsoft Best Practices.
Du erweiterst und optimierst die Benutzeroberfläche mit JavaScript (Xrm.WebApi) und entwickelst eigene PCF Controls, um individuelle Anforderungen nutzerfreundlich umzusetzen.
Du arbeitest sicher mit Solution Layering sowie unserer ALM-Pipeline in Azure DevOps und verantwortest Branching-Strategien, Pull Requests und automatisierte Deployments.
Du integrierst Dynamics 365 mit Azure Services wie Azure Functions, Service Bus oder Application Insights und implementierst robuste sowie skalierbare Schnittstellen.
Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für Features, von der Anforderungsklärung und Aufwandsschätzung über die technische Umsetzung bis hin zur Testunterstützung und dem produktiven Rollout.
Du bringst dich aktiv in Code Reviews ein, förderst einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch im Team und treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Engineering-Praktiken voran.
Du arbeitest unterstützt Junior-Entwickler:innen durch Mentoring, Pair Programming und konstruktives Feedback.

DEINE STÄRKEN.

Du begeisterst dich dafür, mit modernen Microsoft-Technologien eine leistungsfähige CRM-Plattform für ein sinnstiftendes Geschäft zu gestalten. Dabei bringst du fundierte technische Expertise ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und arbeitest gerne gemeinsam mit anderen an nachhaltigen Lösungen.

WAS WIR BENÖTIGEN.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung (mindestens 4 Jahre) in der Entwicklung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse und der Power Platform sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript und der Entwicklung von Plugins, Workflows und Power Automate Flows.
Fundiertes Know-how in der Erweiterung und Integration von Dynamics 365, einschließlich Xrm.WebApi, Azure Services (z. B. Functions, Service Bus, Application Insights, Key Vault) sowie der Entwicklung robuster Schnittstellen.
Sicherer Umgang mit ALM-Konzepten und modernen Entwicklungsprozessen, insbesondere Solution Layering, Managed und Unmanaged Solutions, Git, Azure DevOps Pipelines und Pull-Request-basiertem Arbeiten.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1/B2).

DAS WÄRE SCHÖN.

Erfahrung mit PCF Controls (Power Apps Component Framework) sowie Test-Frameworks im Power-Platform-Umfeld, beispielsweise FakeXrmEasy oder XrmUnitTest.
Eine Microsoft-Zertifizierung wie PL-400 oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Funktionsbereich Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales.
Kenntnisse von Integrationslösungen wie API Management, Logic Apps oder Event Grid.

DEINE VORTEILE UND BENEFITS BEI UNS.

WORK-LIFE-BALANCE.
Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub | Home-Office-Optionen | Sabbatical | Bis zu 180 Tage Arbeiten im Ausland | Urlaub und Workation in unseren Seminarhäusern in Berlin und Pommritz | Zahlreiche Angebote und Rabatte über Corporate Benefits

GESUNDHEIT.
Mache mit bei Firmenläufen | Sport- und Entspannungsangebote mit Voiio | Jobrad | Firmenfitness mit EGYM Wellpass | Yoga-Retreats | Nahrungsergänzungsmittel | Ergonomische Arbeitsplatzausstattung | Coaching- und Beratungsangebote

PERSÖNLICHE ENTWICKLUNG.
Bilde dich weiter mit diversen Trainingsangeboten | Drei Weiterbildungstage | Individuelle fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung | LinkedIn Learning | Teamentwicklungen | Leadership Management Programm | Microsoft 365 mit Copilot

BERUF UND FAMILIE
. Profitiere von sehr guter Vereinbarkeit von Karriere und Familie | Bezahlte Kinderkrankentage | Familienurlaub in unseren Seminarhäusern | Bezahlter Sonderurlaub für die Pflege von Angehörigen | Digitale Kinderbetreuung und Nachhilfe mit Voiio

new_jobs.description:
Mit über 2.800 Expert:innen weltweit, 33 Standorten und 30+ Jahren Microsoft-Erfahrung gestalten wir individuelle und innovative Businesslösungen - technologisch, menschlich und partnerschaftlich.

Wir gehören seit 21 Jahren zur Microsoft Inner Circle Elite – der Top 1 % weltweit – und wurden bereits 26-mal zum Microsoft Partner of the Year gekürt. Was das für dich heißt? Zugang zu modernster Microsoft-Technologie, echte Einflussmöglichkeiten und Projekte, die etwas bewegen.

Ob internationales Projekt oder Deep Dive in Cloud-Innovationen: Bei HSO bist du nicht nur Teil des Fortschritts – du gestaltest ihn mit. Du willst mehr als Standardberatung? Dann steig bei uns ein.

Aufgaben

Entwurf und Entwicklung von Lösungsarchitekturen für Microsoft Dynamics CRM-Projekte
Beratung unserer Kunden bei der Definition ihrer Anforderungen und der Auswahl geeigneter Technologien
Bewertung und Auswahl von Technologien und Tools im Microsoft Dynamics CRM Umfeld
Erstellung von technischen Konzepten und Architekturdesigns
Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards und Best Practices
Aktive Teilnahme am Pre-Sales Prozess, technischen Diskussionen und Workshops

Requirements

Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Fachinformatiker Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Solution Architecture im Microsoft Dynamics CRM Umfeld
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung und -architektur im Microsoft Dynamics CRM Umfeld
Übergreifende Kenntnisse der verschiedenen CRM-Module, der Architektur sowie Kenntnisse von Schnittstellentechnologien
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien (z.B. Azure)
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch– und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Result Orientation: Du arbeitest bei einem der global größten und erfolgreichsten Microsoft-Partner im Bereich Microsoft Dynamics 365 und treibst damit die digitale Transformation voran
Self Determination: Bei uns steht die Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe im Mittelpunkt - mit deinen Ideen und Erfahrungen kannst du dich bei uns einbringen, eigenständig agieren und damit den Unternehmenserfolg aktiv mitgestalten
Team Spirit: Da Menschen bei HSO den Unterschied machen, kannst du dich auf eine unterstützende, vertrauensvolle und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre freuen
Learning & Growth: Wir werden dich mit Trainingsangeboten durch unsere hauseigene HSO Academy und externe Schulungspartner in Kombination mit einem individuellen Karrierepfad fördern
Onboarding@HSO: Wir heißen dich in unserem Office in Böblingen willkommen - du startest deine ersten Onboarding-Tage bei uns vor Ort, um dich mit unserer Unternehmenskultur, unseren Prozessen und Tools vertraut zu machen

Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.
You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.
This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.
What you'll doAdvise on AI trust and governance. Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.
Scope and shape AI build projects. Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.
Build and deliver. Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.
Own the relationship through delivery. Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.
What we're looking forMust-haves 5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).
Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.
Machine Learning Expertise:
Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.
Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.
Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.
Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.

Strong pluses Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.
Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).
Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.
Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.
Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.
Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.

How we'll measure success Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.
Why this role, why now AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.

Our culture promotes autonomy and collaboration, empowering individuals to thrive within self-organising teams. In your daily activities, you will collaborate with a team of Architects who design effective solutions, and with the Development team, which ensures the highest standards of software.

We process over a billion records at a time, our engineers are responsible for the data analysis and construction and optimization of data flow processes. Collaborate closely across disciplines — work effectively with other QAs, Product Owner, ETL/MS/UI developers, and UX designer to align on requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, share test coverage, and resolve defects efficiently across the full data-to-dashboard delivery chain

new_jobs.description:
Verantwortung

Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Microsoft- und Netzwerkinfrastrukturen
Betreuung von Firewall-, Security-, Netzwerk- und WLAN-Lösungen sowie Analyse komplexer Störungen im 2nd-Level-Support
Planung, Testing und Implementierung von Server-, Datenbank- und Infrastrukturkomponenten
Erstellung und Rollout von Softwarepaketen sowie Business-Applikationen für mehrere tausend Anwenderinnen und Anwender
Mitarbeit in Infrastruktur-, Migrations- und Digitalisierungsprojekten sowie Unterstützung bei Pikett- und Noteinsätzen

Qualifikationen

Informatikausbildung EFZ oder vergleichbare technische Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung als System Engineer
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Windows Server, AD Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO und MS SQL Server
Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, Netzwerk, Firewall, Cloud Security und Virtualisierung
Praxiserfahrung mit PowerShell, Scripting oder Automatisierung sowie Client-Images und Softwarepaketierung
Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit guten Deutschkenntnissen und technischem Englisch

Benefits

Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte
Eingespieltes und dynamisches Team
Beteiligung an gesundheitlichen Massnahmen
Interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten/Projekte
Flache Hierarchien
Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, Kinderbetreuung

new_jobs.description:
Devoteam es una consultora europea líder enfocada en estrategia digital, plataformas

tecnológicas, ciberseguridad y transformación empresarial a través de la tecnología.

Centrada en 6 áreas de especialización, abordamos los desafíos estratégicos de nuestros

clientes: Digital Business & Products, Data-driven Intelligence, Distributed Cloud, Business

Automation, Ciberseguridad y la Sostenibilidad conseguida por la Digitalización.

La Tecnología está en nuestro ADN y creemos en ella como una palanca capaz de impulsar

el cambio para mejorar, manteniendo un equilibrio que nos permite ofrecer a nuestros

clientes herramientas tecnológicas de primer nivel pero siempre con la cercanía y

profesionalidad de un equipo que actúa como guía durante el camino.

Nuestros 25 años de experiencia
nos convierten en una consultora innovadora,

consolidada y madura que permite el desarrollo de nuestras 8.500 personas
, certificando

continuamente a nuestros consultores en las últimas tecnologías y contando con expertos

en: Cloud, BI, Data Analytics, Excelencia en Procesos de Negocio, Gestión de la Relación

con clientes, Ciberseguridad, Marketing Digital, Machine Learning, Ingeniería y desarrollo

del Software.

Devoteam ha sido premiado como Partner del año 2021 de los 5 líderes de la nube: AWS,

Google Cloud, Microsoft, Salesforce y ServiceNow.

#CreativeTechForBetterChange

Descripción del empleo

Estamos en búsqueda de un/a Desarrollador/a de aplicaciones con .NET 8 y arquitecturas limpias
con la siquiente experiencia:

Experiencia mínima de 3 años en desarrollo con .NET Core / C#.
Experiencia reciente con .NET 8.
Conocimientos sólidos de Clean Architecture, arquitectura hexagonal y DDD.
Experiencia en arquitecturas de microservicios y desarrollo de APIs REST.
Aplicación de principios SOLID, patrones de diseño y buenas prácticas.
Experiencia con testing, Git y bases de datos relacionales.
Capacidad para comprender requerimientos funcionales y transformarlos en soluciones técnicas de calidad.

Skills:

Autonomía demostrable para comprender, desarrollar y entregar funcionalidades de principio a fin.

Mentalidad abierta, humildad profesional y receptividad al feedback.

Capacidad para identificar riesgos, plantear dudas y solicitar ayuda cuando sea necesario.
